# Nama ERP Documentation

> User and support documentation for Nama ERP. Every page listed here, except the Entity Flows
> Reference (/entity-flows/, English only), has an Arabic mirror at the same path under /ar -
> https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/accounts.html is
> https://docs.namasoft.com/ar/modules/accounting/accounts.html in Arabic. "(ar: ...)" after a
> link is the title of that Arabic mirror. A title shared by several pages, or too generic to
> stand alone, carries its parent sections in brackets. "entities:" lists the screens the page
> covers and "screens (ar):" their Arabic on-screen names. "licence:" lists the licence codes a
> page's feature needs. The database schema (tables, columns, enums) is a separate site:
> https://dm.namasoft.com

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/) (ar: بدء الاستخدام): Landing page for new users and implementers: what Nama ERP is, the glossary, minimum requirements, installation, configuration files and securing sign-in.
- [What is Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/what-is-nama-erp.html) (ar: ما هو نظام نما؟): The core ideas behind Nama ERP for new support staff: one database, master files versus documents, modules and the platform, and the document lifecycle from draft to commit, revision and deletion.
- [Glossary of Nama ERP Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/nama-erp-glossary.html) (ar: معجم مصطلحات نظام نما): Arabic-English glossary of recurring Nama ERP terms, grouped by subject (records, document behaviour, states, dates, ownership, fields and screens), with the pairs that get mixed up.
- [System Minimum Requirements](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/system-minimum-requirements.html) (ar: الحد الأدنى لمتطلبات تشغيل النظام): Minimum and recommended server hardware and software for an on-premise Nama ERP installation, supported browsers, and the options for cloud hosting.
- [Nama ERP Installation Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/installation-guide.html) (ar: دليل تثبيت Nama ERP): How to install Nama ERP on Tomcat and SQL Server with the Nama installer: prerequisites, database setup, SSL, confirming the install, upgrading, and fixing common installer problems.
- [nama.properties](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/nama-properties.html) (ar: ملف nama.properties): nama.properties is the one file that tells an installation what it is: what to call itself, where its files live, which addresses it hands out, and which of the system's safety valves are open.
- [Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/two-factor-authentication.html) (ar: دليل المصادقة الثنائية (2FA)): Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to the Nama ERP login process by requiring users to provide a second form of verification beyond their username and password. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Licensing, and Why a Screen or Field Is Missing](https://docs.namasoft.com/getting-started/licensing.html) (ar: الترخيص، ولماذا تغيب شاشة أو حقل): How the Nama ERP licence works: where it lives, what it limits (modules, concurrent users, user levels, legal entities, POS machines), how to read it, and every reason a screen or field can be missing, in checking order.

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/) (ar: البنية المعمارية): Landing page for the technical architecture of Nama ERP: application architecture, infrastructure and deployment, and security architecture, written for IT and server administrators.
- [Application Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/application-architecture.html) (ar: البنية المعمارية للتطبيق): The architecture of Nama ERP as one Java web application on one server and one database: its technology stack, layers, functional modules, what happens when a document is saved, client apps, integrations, multi-company data and reporting.
- [Infrastructure Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/infrastructure-architecture.html) (ar: بنية البنية التحتية): How Nama ERP is deployed and run: the standard single-server topology, what to build, network ports, where data lives, backup and recovery, availability, upgrades and multi-site setups.
- [Security Architecture](https://docs.namasoft.com/architecture/security-architecture.html) (ar: البنية الأمنية): Nama ERP security for reviewers: login controls (LDAP, two-factor, lockout, session limits), the layered permission checks deciding what a user can reach, audit trails proving who did what, data protection, and where responsibility sits.

## Platform Features

- [Platform Features](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/) (ar: الخصائص العامة للنظام): The system-wide tools shared by every Nama ERP module: records and numbering, global configuration, screen and menu customisation, security and governance, automation and data import, reports, dashboards and notifications, and everyday shortcuts.

### Everyday Tools

- [Everyday Tools](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/) (ar: أدوات يومية): The small things every user touches daily, whichever module they work in: the buttons every screen shares, keyboard shortcuts, the search box in the top bar, help text on fields, themes, notes and agenda items on records...
- [Buttons on Every Screen](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/screen-buttons.html) (ar: الأزرار الموجودة في كل شاشة): The buttons shared by every Nama ERP screen: the edit screen toolbar and its More menu, printing and the export dialog, the list screen toolbar, the buttons on a grid, and why a button can be missing.
- [Remarks, Agenda and Work Tasks](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/remarks-and-agenda.html) (ar: الملحوظات والأجندة ومهام العمل): How to write remark records against any record, read them back, classify them with Remark Types, and use the employee agenda and work tasks, including splitting a task across several people. - entities: Remark, DetailedRemark, MeetingRemark, WorkTask, EmployeeAgenda, RemarkType - screens (ar): ملاحظة, ملحوظة مفصلة, ملحوظات اجتماع, مهمة عمل, أجندة موظف, نوع ملاحظة
- [Default Values Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/default-values-templates.html) (ar: قوالب القيم الافتراضية): How to create Default Values Templates that pre-fill header fields and detail lines on new records, who gets each template, when it applies automatically and how to apply one on demand. - entities: DefaultValuesTemplate - screens (ar): قالب قيم افتراضية - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Default Values Template
- [Preventing a Record From Being Used](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/prevent-usage.html) (ar: منع استعمال سجل): How to retire a record with Prevent Usage and Allow Usage from the More menu, how a retired record shows, what it stops, the related visibility settings and Prevent Usage As From Doc.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/shortcuts.html) (ar: اختصارات لوحة المفاتيح): Every keyboard shortcut in Nama, grouped by where it works: support and debug keys, grids, the find bar, reference and date fields, the criteria editor, menus and search, chat, login, the business functions on edit and list screens, and the POS.
- [Searching From the Top Bar](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/global-search.html) (ar: البحث من الشريط العلوي): How the top-bar search box (Ctrl + K) finds screens, records and fields: why screen names are matched before records, narrowing the search to one kind of record, jumping to a field with f:, and the settings that configure it.
- [Field Help and Tooltips](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/field-help-and-tooltips.html) (ar: مساعدة الحقول والمساعدات السريعة): How to add help to fields and messages: Entity Help for fixed explanations of fields and error messages, and Tooltip Definition for query-based answers shown on demand in a field. - entities: EntityHelp, TooltipDefinition - screens (ar): ملف مساعدة, تعريف مساعدة سريعة
- [Themes](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/ui-themes.html) (ar: الثيمات (Themes)): Themes in the modern interface: picking a theme and switching between light and dark, the dark top bar and menu, setting a company's default theme, building custom themes, and the thirteen built-in system themes. - entities: GUITheme - menu: Administration → Display Customization → New GUI Theme
- [The Top Bar and Your User Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/top-bar-and-user-menu.html) (ar: الشريط العلوي وقائمة المستخدم): The top bar of the modern interface: what each icon does, switching the login company, branch and other dimensions from the bar, switching language, and the user menu — My Profile, contact info, password change, GUI Preferences, QR Info, the old interface and signing out.
- [Quick Create and Quick Edit from a Field](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/everyday-tools/quick-create-and-quick-edit.html) (ar: الإنشاء السريع والتعديل السريع من حقل مرجع): The reference field's pop-up window: searching for a record, creating a new customer, item or other record without leaving the screen (Quick Create), editing the chosen record in place (Quick Edit), picking several records at once in a grid, and the keys F4, F6, F7 and F8.

### Documents and Records

- [Documents and Records](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/) (ar: المستندات والسجلات): Every screen in Nama ERP saves one of two things: a document — something that happens on a date, such as an invoice or a voucher — or a master file that documents point at, such as a customer or an item.
- [The Life of a Document: Draft, Commit, Approval, Revise, Cancel](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/document-lifecycle.html) (ar: حياة المستند: المسودة والاعتماد والموافقة والمراجعة والإلغاء): Every screen in Nama has a Save button and a Draft button, and every document in the system moves through the same short life: it is started as a draft, committed into a real document, possibly routed for approval, possibly signed off by a reviewer... - entities: DocumentFile
- [Document Books](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/document-books.html) (ar: دفاتر المستندات (Document Books)): The Document Book screen: how a book numbers one document type, building the number and restarting it each year, drafts, running out of numbers, what locks after use, retiring a book, who may use it, and the behaviour it sets for its documents. - entities: DocumentBook - screens (ar): دفتر مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Book
- [Document Cancel Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/document-cancel-document.html) (ar: مستند إلغاء مستند (Document Cancel Document)): The Document Cancel Document screen: how a committed document is cancelled since there is no un-commit, what committing the cancellation does, what blocks it, restoring the documents, documents sent to a tax authority, and the messages you may see. - entities: DocumentCancelDocument - menu: Basic → Documents → Document Cancel Document
- [Recovering and Finding Records](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/recovering-and-finding-records.html) (ar: استعادة السجلات والبحث عنها): How to restore a deleted record from the Recycle Bin (what lands there, restoring, who can use it, emptying it) and how to find any record by code with the All Records screen. - entities: EntityVersion, EntitySystemEntry
- [Why a Record Will Not Save or Delete](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/why-a-record-will-not-save-or-delete.html) (ar: لماذا يرفض النظام حفظ سجل أو حذفه): Why Nama refuses to delete or edit a record, check by check in the order they run: the record is used or system-generated, documents are built on it, user permissions, closed periods, revision, usage prevention and approvals, with what to do about each. - entities: DocumentFile, MasterFile - screens (ar): مستند, ملف
- [Messages and Refusals](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/messages-and-refusals.html) (ar: الرسائل وحالات الرفض): Catalogue of the system-wide refusal and error messages (authority, licence, login, saving and deleting, periods, budgets, configuration), what each one protects and where the fix lives. - entities: EntityHelp - screens (ar): ملف مساعدة - menu: Administration → Other → Entity Help
- [Master Groups](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/master-groups.html) (ar: المجموعات (Master Groups)): The Group screen that numbers master-file records such as customers, items and employees: the For Type rule, the group tree beside list screens, what locks once a group is used, and retiring a group. - entities: MasterGroup - screens (ar): مجموعة - menu: Basic → Settings → Group
- [Attachments](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/attachments.html) (ar: المرفقات (Attachments)): Attachment fields on records and on grid lines: attaching, opening, replacing and removing files, where files are stored, finding what is attached where, bulk transfer of files and attachment security.
- [Form Documents — the Escape Hatch](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/form-documents.html) (ar: النماذج — باب الخروج الآمن): Form Documents, the sixteen spare documents for one-off customer needs: what is on the screen, a worked example of renaming, laying out, calculating and validating one, their accounting effects, and the limits to know before promising anything. - entities: FormDoc1, FormDoc2, FormDoc3 - screens (ar): نموذج 1, نموذج 2, نموذج 3 - menu: Basic → Remarks → Form Document 1
- [Spare Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/documents-and-records/spare-master-files.html) (ar: الملفات الرئيسية الاحتياطية): The spare master files under Basic → Remarks for registers no module covers: Subsidiary 1 to 5, which can carry ledger accounts, the remarks family, which cannot, Remark Types, and how to choose. - entities: Subsidiary1, SubsidiaryClass, DetailedRemark, MeetingRemark, Remark, RemarkType - screens (ar): ذمة 1, فئة ذمة, ملحوظة مفصلة, ملحوظات اجتماع, ملاحظة, نوع ملاحظة - menu: Basic → Remarks → Subsidiary 1

### Shared Master Files

- [Shared Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shared-master-files/) (ar: الملفات الرئيسية المشتركة): The master files every Nama ERP module reads: dimensions and composite dimensions, customers, suppliers and other parties, currencies and exchange rates, and the reusable account sides that document terms use.
- [Dimensions and Composite Dimensions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shared-master-files/dimensions-and-composite-dimensions.html) (ar: المحددات والمحددات المركبة): The five dimension master files (Legal Entity, Sector, Branch, Department, Analysis Set), the PUBLIC dimension, composite dimensions, and why a dimension refuses to change. - entities: LegalEntity, Sector, Branch, Department, AnalysisSet - screens (ar): شركة, قطاع, فرع, إدارة, مجموعة تحليلية - menu: Basic → Dimensions → Legal Entity
- [Customers, Suppliers and Other Parties](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shared-master-files/customers-suppliers-and-parties.html) (ar: العملاء والموردون وجهات الصلة): The Customer, Supplier, Contact and Third Party master files, customer credit limits, the Update Customer Information document, and customer change requests raised from the portal. - entities: Customer, Supplier, Contact, ThirdParty, UpdateCustomerInfo, ModifyCustomerInfoReq - screens (ar): عميل, جهة إتصال, جهة ذات صلة, تحديث بيانات عميل, طلب تعديل بيانات العميل - menu: Sales → Master Files → Customer
- [Keywords and Keyword Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shared-master-files/keyword-templates.html) (ar: الكلمات المفتاحية وقوالبها (Keyword Templates)): Keywords on items and customers: the Key Word File and Key Word Value master files, Keyword template records that hand a ready set of keywords to an item or customer, and how the keywords grid behaves on save. - entities: KeywordTemplate, KeyWordFile, KeyWordValue - screens (ar): كلمات مفتاحية, ملف كلمة مفتاحية, قيمة كلمة مفتاحية - menu: Inventory → Master Files → Keyword template
- [Currencies and Exchange Rates](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shared-master-files/currencies-and-exchange-rates.html) (ar: العملات وأسعار الصرف): The Currency master file and the Exchange Rate screen: where to enter daily rates, how the local currency comes from the ledger, how a document picks its rate, and revaluation with Exchange Rate Update. - entities: Currency, ExchangeRate - screens (ar): عملة, سعر صرف - menu: Basic → Documents → Exchange Rate
- [Accounting Side Config](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/shared-master-files/accounting-side-config.html) (ar: جانب محاسبي (Accounting Side Config)): Every document that reaches the general ledger describes its lines the same way: which account to hit, whose subsidiary (portfolio) account to use, which cost-centre dimensions to carry, and what narration to write. - entities: AccountingSideConfig - menu: Basic → Settings → Accounting Side Config

### Payments and Card Terminals

- [Payments and Card Terminals](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/) (ar: المدفوعات وأجهزة البطاقات): How money that changes hands on a payment line is recorded: the payment methods that decide which account each kind of payment lands in, the PGW program that connects a card machine to the cashier's screen...
- [Payment Methods and Payment Terminals](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/payment-methods-and-terminals.html) (ar: طرق الدفع وأجهزة الدفع (Payment Terminals)): The Payment Method, Payment Terminal and Payment Gateway Method Group screens: which account a payment lands in, fees and fee ranges, behaviour on documents, POS cash and shifts, and card terminals. - entities: PaymentMethod, PaymentTerminal, PGWMethodGroup - screens (ar): طريقة دفع - menu: Basic → Master Files → Payment Method
- [PGW: Installing and Setting Up the Card Terminal Program](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/pgw-card-terminal-app.html) (ar: برنامج PGW: تثبيت برنامج جهاز البطاقات وإعداده): Installing and setting up PGW, the Windows program that links Nama on the cashier's PC to a Geidea, Neoleap or InterPay card machine: prerequisites in Nama, COM and TCP/IP connections, testing, upgrading, the transaction log and messages.
- [How a Card Payment Travels Through PGW](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/pgw-card-payment-flow.html) (ar: رحلة الدفع بالبطاقة عبر PGW): When the cashier presses Pay Invoice, four parties take part: the Nama screen in the browser, the PGW program on the same PC, the card machine, and the Nama server. - entities: PaymentTerminal, PGWMethodGroup
- [PGW: Card Refusal Codes](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/pgw-card-refusal-codes.html) (ar: برنامج PGW: رموز رفض البطاقات): When a card payment through PGW fails, the cashier needs to know one thing quickly: is this a card the customer can try again, or a card that will never go through?
- [Receipt Books and Receipt Papers](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/payments/receipt-books.html) (ar: دفاتر الإيصالات والإيصالات): The Receipt Book and Receipt Paper screens for controlling collectors' pre-printed receipt pads: setting up a book, its three counters, naming the receipt used on a voucher or other document, receipts given against cheques, and the messages you may see. - entities: ReceiptBook, ReceiptPaper - screens (ar): دفتر إيصالات - menu: Basic → Master Files → Receipt Book

### Controls and Governance

- [Controls and Governance](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/) (ar: الرقابة والحوكمة): The controls that keep finished work trustworthy: signing records off level by level, closing accounting periods and freezing everything before a date, rules that block or warn on documents that break them, fields that must be filled in...
- [Revise and Unrevise](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/revise-and-unrevise.html) (ar: المراجعة وإلغاء المراجعة): How to revise and unrevise committed records: what revising locks, how many sign-offs are needed, who may revise, the four ways to revise, Detailed Revision Settings and the revision history. - entities: RevisionDoc, DetailedRevisionConfig - screens (ar): مستند مراجعه, إعدادات المراجعة التفصيلية
- [Fiscal Period Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/fiscal-period-control-guide.html) (ar: التحكم في إقفال الفترات المحاسبية (Fiscal Period Control)): The three layers of fiscal period control: the period's open or closed status, Fiscal Year Status Update for closing a period selectively by user or document type, and Ignore Closed Periods exceptions, with how the layers interact and worked examples. - entities: FiscalYearStatusUpdate, FiscalYear - screens (ar): تحديث حالة السنة المالية, سنة مالية - menu: Basic → Master Files → Fiscal Year Status Update
- [Freezing the Past and Overriding Document Dates](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/freeze-processing-and-dates-overrider.html) (ar: تجميد الماضي وتغيير تواريخ المستندات): The Freeze Processing Document, which stops anything dated before a set date from being changed or recalculated, and the Dates Overrider, which sets the issue and value dates a new document opens with: how each works and how a line is chosen. - entities: FreezeProcessingDoc, DatesOverrider - screens (ar): تغيير التواريخ
- [Criteria Based Validation](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/criteria-based-validation.html) (ar: التحقق المبني على المعايير (Criteria Based Validation)): The Criteria Based Validator screen: When/Then rules and queries that refuse, warn or ask for confirmation on save, limiting them to certain users, checking only on change, worked examples and messages. - entities: CriteriaBasedValidator - screens (ar): تحقق بناءا على معايير - menu: Basic → Settings → Criteria Based Validator
- [Required Fields](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/required-fields.html) (ar: الحقول المطلوبة): The Required Fields screen: making a field mandatory always or only when criteria match, including grid fields and minimum line counts, exempting users or cases, what counts as empty, when the check runs, and worked examples. - entities: RequiredFields - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Required Fields
- [Audit Trail and Version History](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/governance/audit-trail.html) (ar: سجل التعديل وتاريخ النسخ (Audit Trail and Version History)): The Audit Trail and Record Detailed Audit Trail of every record: reading the version history, viewing and comparing versions, field-level auditing, reverting a record, and who may see the trail.

### Global Configuration

- [Global Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/) (ar: الإعدادات العامة): The Global Configuration file, the one settings record shared by every module and the whole database: where to find it and a guide to each of its tabs, from decimals, taxes and discounts to documents, security and replication.
- [General (Platform Features › Global Configuration)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-general.html) (ar: عام): The General tab holds the settings that don't belong to any one business area but shape how numbers, dates and text look everywhere: what the second interface language is, how many decimal places a rate carries, how a Hijri date is written... - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Dimensions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-dimensions.html) (ar: المحددات): The Dimensions tab of Global Configuration: legal entity settings, which of the four optional dimensions your installation uses, how strictly a document's dimensions must agree, and how dimensions map onto account code segments. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Documents and Books](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-documents.html) (ar: المستندات والدفاتر): The Documents and Books tab of Global Configuration: how books and document terms are picked and what a term may control, draft numbering, automatic coding of master files, installments, and who may save into a closed fiscal period. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Taxes and e-Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-taxes.html) (ar: الضرائب والفاتورة الإلكترونية): The Taxes and e-Invoice tab of Global Configuration: how each of the four line taxes is described and calculated, the general tax settings, the approximation discount, and the electronic invoice settings. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Discounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-discounts.html) (ar: الخصومات): The Discounts tab of Global Configuration: the general discount settings and, for each of the eight line discounts and the header discount, what it is calculated on and how it interacts with the four taxes. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Accounting and Finance](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-accounting.html) (ar: المحاسبة والمالية): This tab collects the settings that decide when a difference is small enough to ignore, how many account slots a customer or supplier carries, how credit limits and debt ages are tracked, and how payments, budgets and cost behave. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Customers and Sales](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-sales.html) (ar: العملاء والمبيعات): A short tab with three unrelated jobs: deciding who counts as the salesman on a document, how customer codes are formed, and how this installation talks to Nama CRM. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Approvals and Revise](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-approvals.html) (ar: الموافقات والمراجعة): The Approvals and Revise tab of System Settings: the approval engine switch and which approver buttons show, the Revise settings, and record version history. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Security and Login](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-security.html) (ar: الأمان وتسجيل الدخول): Everything about getting into the system and what you can see once you are in: login attempts and sessions, password rules, two-factor authentication, LDAP, record-level visibility, and the public user-registration page. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Performance and Search](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-performance.html) (ar: الأداء والبحث): The Performance and Search tab of System Settings: query time limits, per-user usage limits, and the settings that control how searching behaves. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Appearance](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-appearance.html) (ar: المظهر): How the system looks and how users move around it: what opens at startup, what the login page shows, which fonts and colours are used, and how popups and tooltips behave. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings
- [Entities Screens](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/global-config/global-config-entity-screens.html) (ar: شاشات الكيانات): The Entities Screens tab of System Settings: screen additions, extra pages shown on other entities such as Contacts, record colour coding, and entity images in search results. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings

### Entity Flows

- [Entity Flows](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/) (ar: مسارات الكيان): Entity Flows let you automate the system's reaction to everyday actions — saving, editing, revising a record — without writing any code.
- [Introduction to Entity Flows](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/introduction-to-entity-flows.html) (ar: مقدمة عن مسارات الكيان): How Entity Flows work: when a flow is triggered, creating one and its detail components, the most used elements, running a flow in the background, and what each event does, from creating a record through save, delete and revision to e-invoicing, record view, manual and automatic runs. - entities: EntityFlow - screens (ar): مسار الكيان - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow
- [Importing Data from Excel or Queries](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/excel-and-sql-import-by-entity-flow.html) (ar: استيراد البيانات من Excel أو الاستعلامات): Importing data from Excel sheets and SQL statements: preparing the sheet, the special import functions, advanced Excel import, and the field-map lines that let an Entity Flow or screen button read an attached sheet or a query into records. - entities: EntityFlow - screens (ar): مسار الكيان
- [Entity Flow Examples](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/entity-flow-examples.html) (ar: أمثلة لمسارات كيان): Ready-made Entity Flow recipes: recalculating resource rates, editing a field two documents up, filling a receipt line, creating production order requests or purchase orders per line or supplier, recalculating attendance, expanding serial numbers, converting digits and deleting the source document. - entities: EntityFlow - screens (ar): مسار الكيان - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow
- [Entity Flow FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/entity-flow-faq.html) (ar: أسئلة شائعة عن مسارات الكيان): Answers to common Entity Flow questions: setting a generic reference field, fixing doubled accounting effects, deleting related documents with a purchase invoice, adding a bank charges effect, fetching selling and last purchase prices, calculating the warehouse, and saved records that skip approval. - entities: EntityFlow - screens (ar): مسار الكيان - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow
- [Why an Entity Flow Did Not Run](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/entity-flows/entity-flow-troubleshooting.html) (ar: لماذا لم يعمل مسار الكيان): Why an Entity Flow did not run: the checks the system makes in order, from the flow's target and the user's action to header conditions, the line switch and background runs, plus the order flows run in, failed saves and the messages you may see. - entities: EntityFlow - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Entity Flow

### Reports and Printed Forms

- [Data Sources](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-data-sources.html) (ar: مصادر البيانات (Data Source)): The Data Source screen: a saved query that a Report Wizard or Printing Form Wizard attaches to read data from another table, its Main, Conditions and Security Constraints tabs, and its parameters. - entities: DataSource - screens (ar): مصدر بيانات - menu: Administration → Reports → Data Source
- [Printing Form Wizard](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/printing-form-wizard-guide.html) (ar: أداة إنشاء نماذج الطباعة (Printing Form Wizard)): The Printing Form Wizard: building a printable form such as a sales invoice from lists of header and grid fields, how saving builds the form, sorting, page setup, and choosing when a form is used. - entities: PrintingFormWizard - screens (ar): أداة إنشاء نموذج طباعة - menu: Administration → Reports → Printing Form Wizard
- [Which Printed Form Comes Out](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/printed-form-selection.html) (ar: أي نموذج طباعة سيخرج): How the system picks which printed form comes out when you press Print: which forms are candidates, the hard filter, the order they are tried in, why a chosen form may still not print, multiple layouts, list printing, and tracing a printing complaint to its cause. - entities: ReportDefinition - screens (ar): تعريف تقرير - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Definition
- [Report Styles](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-styles.html) (ar: تنسيقات التقارير (Report Styles)): Creating Report Styles that hold a reusable look for wizard report and form fields: where a style applies and where it does not, attaching one to a field, what an empty style means, the appearance, font, paragraph, border and padding settings, and a practical set. - entities: ReportStyle - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Style
- [Custom Report Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/custom-report-menu.html) (ar: قائمة تقارير مخصصة (Custom Report Menu)): The Custom Report Menu screen: adding entries to a screen's More menu that open a report with parameters filled from the current record or list, ordering them, who sees them, and why one does not show. - entities: CustomReportMenu - menu: Administration → Reports → Custom Report Menu
- [Multi Value Report Parameter](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/multi-value-report-parameters.html) (ar: قيم متعددة لمدخل تقرير (Multi Value Report Parameter)): The Multi Value Report Parameter screen: a saved list of values that a scheduled task or a report-based AI tool passes to a report parameter that accepts several values. - entities: MultiValueReportParameter - menu: Basic → Settings → Multi Value Report Parameter
- [NamaRep Expression Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/reports-namarep-reference.html) (ar: مرجع تعبيرات NamaRep): Catalogue of NamaRep calls for report expressions: translation, dates and Hijri dates, numbers and amounts in words, prices, links to records and reports, creating records, vacation balances, reward points, database queries, security, QR codes, audit trail and system parameters. - entities: ReportDefinition - screens (ar): تعريف تقرير

- [UAE E-Invoicing Integration via Orchida osTax](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/uae-orchida-einvoice-guide.html) (ar: الربط مع الفاتورة الإلكترونية في الإمارات عبر Orchida osTax): NamaERP supports sending electronic invoices to the UAE Federal Tax Authority (FTA) through the Orchida osTax service provider. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - screens (ar): إعدادات مصلحة الضرائب, إرسال مستندات الي مصلحة الضرائب - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [Standard Terms and Conditions Feature Documentation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/standard-terms-feature-documentation.html) (ar: توثيق خاصية الشروط والأحكام القياسية (Standard Terms and Conditions Feature Documentation)): The Standard Terms feature in Nama ERP provides a comprehensive mechanism for tracking terms and conditions in sales documents (invoices, quotations, etc.) and monitoring whether these terms have been fulfilled. - entities: SalesStandardTerm, StandardTermFulfillment, StandardTermExtension - screens (ar): بند بيع قياسي, تحقق البند, تمديد فترة عمل البند - menu: Basic → Master Files → Sales Standard Term
- [Barcode Field Feature for Sequential Scanning](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/barcode-field-feature.html) (ar: ميزة حقل الباركود للمسح المتتالي): A new feature has been developed in Nama ERP to solve the problem of losing focus when scanning item barcodes in browsers.

### Accounting & Banks

- [Accounting & Banks](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/) (ar: الحسابات والبنوك): The NaMa Accounting System is the financial engine of the whole product: every document in Nama — a sales invoice, a stock issue, a payroll run, an asset depreciation — ultimately lands as an accounting effect in the general ledger.
- [Accounting Concepts & First-Time Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/accounting-concepts-and-setup.html) (ar: المفاهيم الأساسية والإعداد المبدئي للحسابات): Before you can record your first entry, the accounting system needs to "know" a few fixed facts about your organization: What is your main currency? - entities: Ledger, AccountChartType, AccountingCalendar, FiscalYear - screens (ar): دفتر حسابات, نوع شجرة حسابات, تقويم, سنة مالية - menu: Accounting → Settings → Ledger - licence: accounting
- [Chart of Accounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/chart-of-accounts.html) (ar: شجرة الحسابات): The chart of accounts is the backbone of your accounting system: a hierarchical structure that classifies everything you own, owe, earn, and spend into logical, branching groups. - entities: AccountsChart, AccountCategory, AccountTaxCategory - screens (ar): شجرة حسابات, تصنيف حساب, تصنيف حساب ضريبي - menu: Accounting → Master Files → Accounts Chart - licence: accounting
- [Accounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/accounts.html) (ar: الحسابات): The Account screen: Detail versus Subsidiary accounts, the debit and credit chart links, consolidation settings, subsidiary types, control flags, budget control, closing an account by date, and its buttons and reports. - entities: Account - menu: Accounting → Master Files → Account - licence: accounting
- [System Accounts & Transaction Exceptions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/system-accounts-and-exceptions.html) (ar: الحسابات النظامية واستثناءات الحركة عليها): How the System Account flag keeps manual accounting documents off control accounts, and the three ways to allow them: the module option, opening periods, and the System Accounts Transactions Exceptions screen. - entities: SystemAccountTransException, Account - screens (ar): استثناءات الحركة على الحسابات النظامية - menu: Accounting → Master Files → System Accounts Transactions Exceptions - licence: accounting
- [Journal Entries & Adjustments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/journal-entries.html) (ar: سندات القيد والتسويات): Recording manual entries with the Journal Entry: header, lines, balancing and the difference account, and cost allocation, plus the Currency Diff Journal, the Exchange Rate Update and the Inter-Company Transfer. - entities: JournalEntry, CurrencyDiffJournal, ExchangeRateUpdate, InterCompanyTransfer - screens (ar): سند قيد, سند قيد فرق عملة, سند تغيير سعر صرف, جارى تحويل شركات - menu: Accounting → Documents → Journal Entry - licence: accounting, accounting-banks
- [Year-End Closing & Period Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/year-end-and-period-control.html) (ar: الإقفال السنوي والتحكم في الفترات): At the end of each fiscal year comes the moment of closing: carrying the year's profit/loss into equity, and closing the result accounts in preparation for a new year. - entities: ClosingEntry, PreventAccTransactions, LedgerReviseDoc - screens (ar): قيد ختامي, منع الحركات على حسابات او ذممم, سند مراجعة حسابات - menu: Accounting → Documents → Closing Entry - licence: accounting
- [Receipt & Payment Vouchers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/receipts-and-payments.html) (ar: سندات القبض والصرف): The receipt and payment chain: requests, orders and vouchers, the receipt voucher screen, its accounting effect, consolidated requests, actions, reports, and preventing a payment from overdrawing the cash box. - entities: ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher, ReceiptOrder, PaymentOrder, RVRequest, PVRequest, ConsolidatedRVRequest, ConsolidatedPVRequest - screens (ar): سند قبض, سند صرف, أمر قبض, أمر صرف, طلب قبض, طلب صرف, طلب قبض مجمع, طلب صرف مجمع - menu: Accounting → Documents → Receipt Voucher - licence: accounting
- [Credit & Debit Notes](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/credit-and-debit-notes.html) (ar: إشعارات الدائن والمدين): How the Credit Note and Debit Note documents adjust a customer's or supplier's balance without cash: the screen fields, settling the related invoice, the accounting effect, actions and reports. - entities: CreditNote, DebitNote - screens (ar): إشعار دائن, إشعار مدين - menu: Accounting → Documents → CreditNote - licence: accounting
- [Aging Allocation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/aging-allocation.html) (ar: تسوية أعمار الديون (Aging Allocation)): The Aging Allocation document: manually matching a party's open debit and credit items so debt-age reports are right, the steps on the screen, what saving does, and reading matches for custom aging reports. - entities: AgingAllocation - menu: Banks → Master Files → Aging Allocation
- [Cashier Shifts (Cash Drawer)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/cashier-shifts.html) (ar: ورديات الكاشير (درج النقدية)): The cashier shift cycle: Open Shift, the simplified Cashier Receipt and Payment Vouchers recorded during it, Close Shift with the cash count and its difference, and the Electronic Receipt Voucher for field collection. - entities: CSHOpenShift, CSHCloseShift, CSHReceiptVoucher, CSHPaymentVoucher, ElectronicReceiptVoucher - screens (ar): سند فتح وردية, سند غلق وردية, سند قبض كاشير, سند صرف كاشير, سند قبض إلكتروني - menu: Accounting → Cashiers → Open Shift - licence: accounting-cashier, accounting-electronic-receipt
- [Banks, Bank Accounts & Transfers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/banks-and-bank-accounts.html) (ar: البنوك والحسابات البنكية والتحويلات): Managing the banking side starts by defining the banks you deal with, then the bank accounts opened with them. - entities: Bank, BankAccount, BankTransfer, BankAdjustment - screens (ar): حساب بنكي, تحويل بنكي, تسوية بنكية - menu: Banks → Master Files → Bank - licence: accounting-banks
- [Bank Reconciliation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-reconciliation.html) (ar: المطابقة البنكية): How Bank Reconciliation matches a bank statement against your bank account transactions in three steps, how unmatched lines become entries, and how it differs from subsidiary reconciliation; the document itself has no accounting effect. - entities: BankReconciliation - screens (ar): مذكرة تسوية بنكية - menu: Banks → Cheques → Bank Reconciliation - licence: accounting-banks
- [Cheques & Financial Papers (Lifecycle)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/cheques-financial-papers.html) (ar: الشيكات والأوراق المالية (دورة الحياة)): A cheque isn't just an amount; it's a paper with a journey: it's received, deposited at the bank, collected or returned, and may be endorsed to another party or discounted before its due date. - entities: FinancialPaper, FPBook, BankPortfolio, BankNotice, OpenningFinancialPaper, FinancialPaperAgio, FinancialPaperCancel, FPTransfer - screens (ar): ورقة تجارية, دفتر أوراق تجارية, حافظة بنكية, إشعار بنكي, إفتتاح ورقة تجارية, أجيو, إلغاء ورقة تجارية, نقل ورقه مالية - menu: Banks → Master Files → Commercial Paper - licence: accounting-banks
- [Bank Loans](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-loans.html) (ar: القروض البنكية): Managing bank loans from request to repayment: loan types, the Bank Loan master file and its statuses, Loan Issue, interest calculation, instalment payments, rescheduling and amendment, with the related buttons and reports. - entities: BankLoan, BankLoanRequest, LoanIssue, LoanInstallmentPayment, LoanInterestsCalculation, BankLoanScheduling, BankLoanChangingDoc, BankLoanType - screens (ar): قرض بنكي, طلب إضافة قرض, سند إصدار قرض, سداد أقساط القرض, سند احتساب فوائد القرض, جدولة قرض بنكي, تعديل قرض, نوع القرض - menu: Banks → Bank Loans → Bank Loan - licence: accounting-loans
- [Fixed Deposits](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/fixed-deposits.html) (ar: الودائع الثابتة): A fixed deposit is the mirror image of a loan: instead of borrowing from the bank, you place an amount with it for a set term in return for interest. - entities: FixedDeposit, FixedDepositIssue, InterestPaymentDocument, FixedDepositChangingDoc - screens (ar): وديعة بنكية, إصدار وديعة, سند إصدار أرباح, سند تعديل وديعة - menu: Banks → Fixed Deposits → Fixed Deposit - licence: accounting-loans
- [Credit Facilities & Facility Limits](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/credit-facilities.html) (ar: التسهيلات الائتمانية وحدود التسهيلات): How bank facility limits (a shared ceiling consumed by loans, guarantees and letters of credit) and credit facilities (issued, repaid and terminated through their own documents) are set up and tracked. - entities: CreditFacility, FacilityLimit, FacilityLimitConfig, CreditFacilitySetting, CreditFacilityIssuance, CreditFacilityPayment, CreditFacilityTermination - screens (ar): تسهيل ائتمانى, حد التسهيلات, إعدادات حد التسهيلات, إعدادات التسهيلات الائتمانية, إصدار تسهيل ائتمانى, مستند سداد تسهيل ائتمانى, مستند انهاء تسهيل ائتمانى - menu: Banks → Credit Facilities → Credit Facility - licence: accounting-loans
- [Letters of Guarantee](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/letters-of-guarantee.html) (ar: خطابات الضمان): A letter of guarantee is an undertaking the bank issues on your behalf in favor of a third party (a government body, a project owner…) guaranteeing that you'll meet some obligation — like a tender-entry guarantee or a contract performance guarantee. - entities: LetterOfGuarantee, LGTIssue, LGTReceipt, LGTDelivery, LGTChanging, LGTClosing, LGTReq - screens (ar): خطاب ضمان, إصدار خطاب ضمان, استلام  خطاب ضمان, تسليم  خطاب ضمان, تعديل خطاب ضمان, إنهاء خطاب ضمان, طلب خطاب ضمان - menu: Banks → Letters Of Guarantee → Letter Of Guarantee - licence: accounting-lgt
- [Bank Letters of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-letters-of-credit.html) (ar: الاعتمادات المستندية البنكية): A letter of credit (LC) is a tool an importer uses to reassure the supplier: the bank undertakes to pay the supplier the shipment's value once they present shipping documents matching the terms. - entities: BankLC, BLCOpeningDoc, BLCChanging, BLCClosingDoc, BLCReq - screens (ar): اعتماد بنكى, فتح اعتماد بنكى, تعديل اعتماد بنكى, إنهاء اعتماد بنكى, طلب اعتماد بنكى - menu: Banks → Bank LC → Bank LC - licence: accounting-blc
- [Treasury Bills](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/treasury-bills.html) (ar: أذون الخزانة): A treasury bill is a short-term investment instrument the state issues: you buy it for less than its nominal value, and at maturity you collect its full value, so the difference is your return. - entities: TreasuryBill, TreasuryBillPurchaseDoc, TrasureyBillROIProofDoc, AggTreasuryBillProofDoc, TreasuryBillSalesDoc, TreasuryBillCloseDoc - screens (ar): إذن خزانة, شراء إذن خزانة, إثبات عائد إذن الخزانة, إثبات عائد أذون خزانة مجمع, بيع إذن خزانة, إقفال إذن خزانة - menu: Banks → Treasury Bill → Treasury Bill - licence: accounting-investment-documents
- [Investment Portfolios](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/investment-portfolios.html) (ar: المحافظ الاستثمارية): Tracking investment assets with Investment Portfolios: the portfolio, investor and project master files, share and stake types, and the lifecycle from Investment Opportunity and Investment Start through updates, capital increases and profit distribution to Investment End. - entities: IPInvestmentPortfolio, IPInvestmentStart, IPInvestmentEnd, IPInvestmentUpdate, IPInvestmentProfitDistribution, IPInvestmentIncreaseCapital, IPInvestmentOpportunity, Investor, InvestmentProject, IPShareType, IPStakeType - screens (ar): محفظة استثمارية, فتح استثمار, إنهاء استثمار, تحديث الاستثمار, توزيع أرباح الاستثمار, زيادة رأس مال الاستثمار, فرصة استثمارية, مستثمر, مشروع استثماري, نوع السهم, نوع الحصة - menu: Accounting → Investment Portfolios → Investment Portfolio - licence: accounting-investment
- [Investment Documents & Fund Certificates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/investment-documents.html) (ar: مستندات الاستثمار وشهادات الصناديق): Beyond the portfolio system that tracks investment assets, Nama has a second investment world for the paper instruments a company buys and holds: bonds and fund certificates. - entities: InvestmentDoc, InvestmentDocumentFund, InvestmentDocPurchase, InvestmentDocROIProof, AggregatedInvestmentDocROIProof, InvestmentDocClaiming, InvestmentDocumentPurchase, InvestmentDocumentSale, InvestmentDocumentPriceUpdate - screens (ar): سند استثمار, صندوق استثمار وثيقة, مستند شراء سند استثمار, مستند إثبات عائد سندات استثمار, مستند إثبات عائد سندات استثمار مجمع, مستند استحقاق سند استثمار, مستند شراء وثائق استثمار, مستند بيع وثيقة, تغيير سعر الوثيقة - menu: Banks → Investment Documents → Investment Document - licence: accounting-investment-documents
- [Partner Shares & Profit Distribution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/partner-shares-and-profit-distribution.html) (ar: أسهم الشركاء وتوزيع الأرباح): How to record each partner's shares on the Partner shares screen and split a period's net profit between partners and management with the Profits Distribution Doc, including the calculation and what it books. - entities: PartnerShares, ProfitDistributationDoc - screens (ar): مستند توزيع أرباح - menu: Accounting → Master Files → Partner shares - licence: accounting, basic
- [Prepaid Expenses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/prepaid-expenses.html) (ar: المصروفات المقدمة): How prepaid expenses are recorded and expensed month by month: the Prepaid Expense Item, the Prepaid Expense Contract, its monthly ledger entries, paying in instalments, and the accounting effect of the contract and of each month. - entities: PrepaidExpenseContract, PrepaidExpenseItem, PrepaidExpenseLedger, PrepaidExpensePayment - screens (ar): عقد مصروف مقدم, بند مصروف مقدم, قيد استحقاق مصروف مقدم, سداد مصروف مقدم - menu: Accounting → Prepaid Expense Contracts → Prepaid Expense Contract - licence: accounting-prepaid-expenses
- [Financial Commitments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-commitments.html) (ar: الالتزامات المالية): A company carries many recurring obligations that aren't invoices yet but are very real: a yearly rent paid in quarterly installments, an insurance policy, a financing agreement with a fixed repayment schedule. - entities: FinancialCommitment, FinancialCommitmentPayDoc, FinancialCommitmentReschedule, FinancialCommitmentCategory - screens (ar): إلتزام مالى, مستند دفع إلتزام مالى, مستند إعادة جدولة إلتزام مالى, فئة إلتزام مالى - menu: Accounting → Financial Commitment Management → Financial Commitment - licence: accounting-financial-commitments-regulation
- [Financial Budgets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-budgets.html) (ar: الموازنات المالية): A budget is a plan with teeth: you decide up front how much each account may spend (or should earn) over a period, and then — if you want — the system holds your documents to that plan, warning or even blocking spending that would blow past it. - entities: FinancialBudget, BudgetScenario - screens (ar): موازنه مالية, سيناريو موازنة - menu: BUDGETS → Budgets → Financial Budget - licence: accounting-budget
- [Financial Statements](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-statements.html) (ar: القوائم المالية): Building income statements, balance sheets and cash-flow reports with the financial-statements engine: FS Account Groups, FS Equations, the FS Settings File template, issuing a statement for a period, and drilling down from a figure. - entities: FSSettingsFile, FSIssueFile, FSAccountGroup, FSEquation, FSIssueLinkConfig - screens (ar): إعدادات قائمة مالية, إصدار قائمة مالية, مجموعة حساب, معادلة, إعدادات رابط اصدار قائمة مالية - menu: Accounting → Financial Statement → FS Settings File - licence: accounting
- [Consolidated Statements](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/consolidated-statements.html) (ar: القوائم المالية الموحدة): The consolidated statements give a group of companies one trial balance, one income statement and one balance sheet, in one reporting currency, with the business the companies did with each other taken out. - licence: accounting
- [Misc Purchasing & Machine Rent](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/misc-purchasing.html) (ar: المشتريات المتنوعة وتشغيل المعدات): Buying services and non-stock items through accounting: the Misc Purchase Request and Order, the Miscellaneous Invoice and its expense effect, Purchase Elements, and the Machine Rent Invoice. - entities: MiscPurchaseInvoice, MiscPurchaseReq, MiscPurchaseOrder, PurchaseElement, MachineRentInvoice - screens (ar): فاتورة متنوعات, طلب شراء متنوعات, أمر شراء متنوعات, بند شراء, فاتورة تشغيل معدات - menu: Accounting → Documents → Miscellaneous Invoice - licence: accounting
- [Party Evaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/party-evaluation.html) (ar: تقييم الجهات): How to score customers, suppliers and banks with Party Evaluation: defining evaluation elements and element groups with weights, and recording a party's evaluation. - entities: PartyEvaluation, PartyEvaluationElement, PartyEvalElementGroup - screens (ar): تقييم جهة, عنصر تقييم جهة, مجموعة نقاط تقييم جهة - menu: Accounting → Party Evaluations → Party Evaluation - licence: accounting
- [Subsidiary Reconciliation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/subsidiary-reconciliation.html) (ar: التسوية مع الذمم): How Subsidiary Reconciliation compares your books for a customer or supplier with their external statement in three steps, matches what agrees and lists the differences, with no accounting effect. - entities: SubsidiaryReconciliation - screens (ar): تسوية مع ذمة - menu: Accounting → Reconciliations → Subsidiary Reconciliation - licence: accounting

#### Technical Reference

- [Technical Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/) (ar: مرجع الدعم الفني)

- [Accounting Configuration (module option catalog)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات الحسابات (كتالوج خيارات الوحدة)): Many of the accounting module's behaviors aren't coded — they're configured from the accounting module's configuration screen (Accounting → Settings → Accounting Configurations). - menu: Accounting → Settings → Accounting Configurations
- [Document Terms (per-type processing rules)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات المستندات (قواعد المعالجة لكل نوع)): What a document term is and how it decides the debit and credit accounts of accounting documents: account sources, conditional sources, taxes and dimension modifiability, the must, may and cannot use options, and an option-by-option reference. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Dimensions, Cost Centers & Distribution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-dimensions-and-distribution.html) (ar: المحدِّدات ومراكز التكلفة والتوزيع): The dimensions carried on ledger lines (legal entity, sector, branch, department, analysis set and more), restricting dimensions per account, and Account Distribution for spreading a value across them. - entities: AccDistribution - screens (ar): توزيع حسابات - menu: Accounting → Settings → Account Distribution
- [Fiscal Periods, Period Locking & Multi-Currency](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-periods-and-currency.html) (ar: الفترات المالية وإقفال الفترات وتعدّد العملات): Fiscal years and periods, opening and locking periods, and how documents in more than one currency are handled: why a document will not save into a date and why a foreign-currency balance changes. - entities: FiscalYear, FiscalYearStatusUpdate - screens (ar): سنة مالية, تحديث حالة السنة المالية - menu: Basic → Master Files → Fiscal Year

#### Accounting Document Terms

- [Accounting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الحسابات): Every accounting document that creates a journal entry takes its accounts from its document term (توجيه) — so when a voucher lands on the wrong account, a cheque moves to an unexpected status, or a letter of guarantee creates no journal entry...
- [Receipt, Payment and Request Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-vouchers-and-requests.html) (ar: توجيهات سندات القبض والصرف والطلبات): The document term options for receipt and payment vouchers, orders and bank transfers: where each side's account comes from, what the voucher may carry, copying from the source document and extra effects, plus payment and receipt requests, the Electronic Receipt Voucher and cashier documents. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Journal, Closing and Other Accounting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-journals-and-closing.html) (ar: توجيهات القيود والإقفال ومستندات الحسابات الأخرى): A journal entry's lines name their own accounts, so its term has no debit and credit sides to fill — it is about guard rails instead: which dimensions a user may change, and what to do when the entry does not balance. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Credit/Debit Note and Miscellaneous Invoice Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-notes-and-misc-invoices.html) (ar: توجيهات الإشعارات الدائنة والمدينة وفواتير المتنوعات): Credit and debit notes adjust what a customer or supplier owes without moving goods, and the miscellaneous invoices bill things that are not stock items — services, rent, utilities, machine hire. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Commercial Paper Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-commercial-papers.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الأوراق التجارية): Document term settings for the commercial paper (cheque) documents: opening papers, bank portfolio, bank notice, partial payment, cancellation, agio and FP transfer, and the accounts each one moves value between. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Letter of Guarantee and Letter of Credit Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-guarantees-and-credits.html) (ar: توجيهات خطابات الضمان والاعتمادات البنكية): The document term account sides for letter of guarantee issue, opening, changing and closing documents, and for letters of credit: which account is debited and credited for the value, cash cover, fees, tax and facility usage. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Loan, Deposit and Credit Facility Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-loans-deposits-facilities.html) (ar: توجيهات القروض والودائع والتسهيلات الائتمانية): The document term account sides for bank loan issue, instalment payment and interest calculation, for credit facilities and for fixed deposits: which amount of the document each debit and credit pair picks up. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Investment and Prepaid Expense Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-investments-and-prepaid.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الاستثمار والمصروفات المقدمة): The document term account sides for treasury bills, investment documents (bonds and fund certificates), investment portfolios and prepaid expenses: the debit and credit pairs for face value, return, tax, premium and discount. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Supply Chain

- [Supply Chain](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/) (ar: سلسلة التوريد): Overview of the Supply Chain module: how purchasing, stock movement, production and sales documents fit together, how documents work in Nama, and a map of the guides on items, purchases, sales, sub-modules, configuration and reports.

- [Units of Measure](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/units-of-measure.html) (ar: وحدات القياس (Units of Measure)): Nama holds every item's stock in one single unit and lets each document speak a different one, so a distributor can buy a product by the carton, sell it by the piece and report on it by the litre without anyone doing the arithmetic by hand. - entities: UOM, UOMGroup, UOMConversions, StandardMeasures, CalculationFormula, InvItem - screens (ar): وحدة قياس, مجموعة وحدات, تحويل وحدات, أبعاد قياسية, صيغة حسابية, صنف

#### Development Request Notes

- [Development Request Notes](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/) (ar: ملاحظات طلبات التطوير): Index of Supply Chain development request notes: untagged quantities for batch and expiry items before a cut-off date, and stock receipts for the unsatisfied part of a purchase order.
- [Allowing Items With Batch & Expiry to Hold Untagged Quantities](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/allow-empty-item-dimensions-before-date.html) (ar: السماح للأصناف ذات الدفعات وتواريخ الصلاحية بحمل كميات غير موسومة (Allowing Items With Batch & Expiry to Hold Untagged Quantities)): Development request SRDRQ06261: the per-dimension cut-off date on Item Configurations that lets items tracked by batch, serial or other dimensions keep moving untagged stock dated before it. - entities: ItemConfigurations - screens (ar): إعدادات صنف - menu: Inventory → Settings → Item Configurations
- [Stock Receipts for the Unsatisfied Part of a Purchase Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/stock-receipt-for-unsatisfied-order-quantities.html) (ar: سند توريد مخزني للجزء غير المنفّذ من أمر الشراء (Stock Receipts for the Unsatisfied Part of a Purchase Order)): Development request SRDRQ06178: term options that keep a stock receipt in step with a purchase order's unsatisfied quantity, hide fully executed orders, and date or split receipts a purchase invoice generates. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
