- [Overdraft & Quantity Checking Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/overdraft-and-quantity-checking.html) (ar: إعدادات السحب على المكشوف والتأكد من الكميات): The Overdraft & Quantity Checking tab: when stock may go negative, the immediate and by-date balance checks, the overdraft policy and the document and term switches, manufacturing and assembly exceptions, reservation, and the messages shown. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Quantity Suggestion Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/quantity-suggestion-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات اقتراح الكميات (Quantity Suggestion Configuration)): The Quantity Suggestion tab: the order in which lots, serials, sizes, warehouses and locators are suggested on document lines, what gets suggested and shown, and how similar lines are merged when documents are copied or consolidated. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Item Properties Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/item-properties-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات خصائص الصنف): The Item Properties tab: in which documents lot, serial, revision, size and color, and measures are entered, item dimension options, production and expiry dates, active and inactive percentages, and the checks when editing linked stock documents. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Items & Master Data Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/items-and-master-data-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات الأصناف والبيانات الرئيسية): This page documents the Items & Master Data tab — settings that affect the item master, item codes and coding, item search (including button/level browsers), the item–warehouse–locator relationships, and item links to customers and suppliers. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Purchasing Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/purchasing-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات المشتريات): This page documents the Purchasing tab — settings that affect purchase orders, purchase invoices, purchase returns, and the letter-of-credit / proforma workflow. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Sales & Offers Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/sales-and-offers-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات المبيعات والعروض): This page documents the Sales & Offers tab — settings for sales documents, offers and coupons, discounts, free items, and the price classifiers used in pricing. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Pricing & Price Lists Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/pricing-and-price-lists.html) (ar: إعدادات التسعير وقوائم الأسعار): This page documents the Pricing & Price Lists tab — how the system falls back to the last price an item was traded at, how price lists behave, and the default units for new items. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Documents & Details Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/documents-and-details-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات المستندات والتفاصيل): This page documents the Documents & Details tab — how stock document lines are laid out, which dimensions can be entered per line, the extra columns and grids you can add to documents, delivery handling, and warehouse/locator filtering. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Stock Taking Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/stock-taking-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات الجرد المخزني): This page documents the Stock Taking tab — settings that govern how physical counts (stock taking) are entered, validated, ended, and turned into adjustment documents. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Stock Ages Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/stock-ages-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات أعمار المخزون): The Stock Ages tab: the Track Stock Ages switch and its item and item section inheritance, the tracking dimensions that split aged stock, and how background processing builds the aging records. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations
- [Item Barcode Specifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/configuration/item-barcode-specifications.html) (ar: مواصفات باركود الصنف): This page documents the Barcode Specifications tab — the rules that tell the system how to read a composite/structured barcode and turn it into an item plus its properties and quantity. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Inventory → Settings → Supply Chain Configurations

#### Document Terms

- [Document Terms (Modules › Supply Chain)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات المستندات): A Document Term (توجيه المستند) is the main mechanism for customizing how a Supply Chain document type behaves.
- [General Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-general.html) (ar: إعدادات عامة (General)): A Document Term (توجيه المستند) is the main mechanism for customizing how a document type behaves in Nama — one document type can have several terms, each shaping its validation, generation, pricing, accounting and more. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [From-Document Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-from-document.html) (ar: إعدادات النسخ من المستند (From-Document)): The from document (بناءً على) is the source document a new document is created from — for example a Sales Order that a Sales Invoice is built on. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Sub-Item Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-sub-item.html) (ar: إعدادات الصنف الفرعي (Sub-Item)): A sub-item (الصنف الفرعي) is a serialized/tracked sub-unit of an item that carries its own warehouse, locator, taxes, status and back-links to the documents that created or touched it. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Quantity Tracking Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-quantity-tracking.html) (ar: إعدادات متابعة الكميات (Quantity Tracking)): These settings control quantity tracking — the engine that links documents and records how much of a source document has been satisfied by the documents created from it (for example, how much of a Sales Order has been invoiced or delivered). - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Reservation & Delivery System](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-reservation-and-delivery.html) (ar: الحجز ونظام التسليم (Reservation & Delivery System)): These settings control how a document reserves stock for its lines and how it participates in the delivery system — the system table that tracks an order through reservation, loading, and final delivery. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Pricing, Taxes & Discounts Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-pricing-taxes-discounts.html) (ar: إعدادات الأسعار والضرائب والخصومات (Pricing, Taxes & Discounts)): This tab controls how unit prices, discounts, and taxes are calculated on documents created under the term — whether they are forced from price lists, recalculated on save, locked after a from-document, or excluded from item cost. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Accounting Effects Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-accounting-effects.html) (ar: إعدادات التأثيرات المحاسبية (Accounting Effects)): Supply Chain documents that carry accounting effects record them in the general ledger through configurable debit and credit account sides. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Generation & Dimensions Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-generation-and-dimensions.html) (ar: إعدادات التوليد والمحددات (Generation & Dimensions)): This page covers two related areas of the supply-chain Document Term: how a document automatically generates downstream documents (on commit, or auto/async on save), and how the document's accounting dimensions (محددات: branch, sector, department... - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Document-Specific Options](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-document-specific.html) (ar: خيارات خاصة بأنواع المستندات (Document-Specific)): Most term-config options are shared across document types and are covered on the other pages (General, From-Document, Quantity Tracking, Reservation & Delivery, Pricing/Taxes/Discounts, Sub-Item). - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Freight Management

- [Freight Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/) (ar: إدارة الشحن): Overview of the Freight Management module for shipping, forwarding, customs-clearance and postal companies: service items instead of stock, the Operation Order at the centre, how a forwarder earns its margin, key terms, licensing and the guide's sections.
- [Freight Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-master-files.html) (ar: الملفات الأساسية لإدارة الشحن): The Freight master files: service items and their flags, containers with their types and sizes, vessels, ports and sailing schedules, commodities, countries, locations, bill of lading types and units. - entities: FRMServiceItem, FRMContainer, FRMContainerType, FRMContainerSize, FRMOceanVessel, ShippingPort, FRMSailingSchedule, FRMCommodity, FRMBillOfLadingType, FRMUOM, FRMCountry, FRMLocation - screens (ar): بند خدمة, حاوية, نوع حاوية, حجم حاوية, سفينة بحرية, ميناء شحن, جدول إبحار, سلعة, نوع بوليصة شحن, وحدة شحن, دولة, موقع شحن
- [Operation Orders](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/operation-orders.html) (ar: أوامر التشغيل (Operation Orders)): The FRM Operation Order, the complete shipment file: parties, voyage and container data, service lines with costs and selling prices, its buttons, the operation order status, the Delivery, Receipt and Transfer documents, and the messages shown. - entities: FRMOperationOrder, FRMOOStatus, FRMOODelivery, FRMOOReceipt, FRMOOTransfer - screens (ar): أمر تشغيل, حالة أمر تشغيل, مستند تسليم أمر تشغيل, مستند استلام أمر تشغيل, مستند نقل أمر تشغيل - menu: Freight Management System → Documents → FRM Operation Order
- [Bills of Lading](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/bills-of-lading.html) (ar: بوالص الشحن (Bills of Lading)): The bill of lading is the official shipping document that proves the carrier's receipt of the goods and the terms of their carriage and delivery. - entities: FRMBillOfLading - screens (ar): بوليصة شحن - menu: Freight Management System → Documents → Bill of Lading
- [Price Lists & Markups](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-pricing.html) (ar: قوائم الأسعار والهوامش): The freight Service Purchase Price List and Service Sales Price List: their fields and service-type lines, markups, how operation orders pick up prices, and how a sale is linked to its cost. - entities: FRMSalesPriceList, FRMPurchasePriceList, FRMEditPurchasePriceList - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار مبيعات خدمات, قائمة أسعار شراء خدمات, تعديل قائمة أسعار مشتريات خدمة
- [From Supplier Rates to Customer Quotations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-price-list-workflow.html) (ar: من أسعار الموردين إلى عروض أسعار العملاء): Working with freight price lists: the price list elements behind each line, loading supplier rates, turning them into a customer quotation, re-pricing it, and bulk changes with Edit Purchase Price List. - entities: FRMPurchasePriceList, FRMPPriceListElement, FRMSalesPriceList, FRMSPriceListElement, FRMEditPurchasePriceList - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار شراء خدمات, عنصر قوائم أسعار شراء, قائمة أسعار مبيعات خدمات, عنصر قوائم أسعار بيع, تعديل قائمة أسعار مشتريات خدمة
- [Invoices & Returns](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-invoicing.html) (ar: الفواتير والمرتجعات): Freight sales and purchase documents: the Sales Order, Sales Invoice and Sales Return, the Purchase Invoice and Purchase Return, how they link to the operation order, and their term configuration and accounting effect. - entities: FRMSalesInvoice, FRMPurchaseInvoice, FRMSalesOrder, FRMSalesReturn, FRMPurchaseReturn - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات خدمة, فاتورة مشتريات خدمة, أمر بيع خدمة, مردود مبيعات خدمة, مردود مشتريات خدمة
- [Storage Locations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-storage-locations.html) (ar: مواقع التخزين (Storage Locations)): Freight storage locations: setting up FRM Location with capacity, section, type and class, the space an operation order needs, and the receipt, transfer and delivery documents that move cargo. - entities: FRMLocation, FRMLocationSection, FRMLocationClass, FRMLocationType, FRMOOReceipt, FRMOOTransfer, FRMOODelivery, FRMOOStatus - screens (ar): موقع شحن, قسم موقع شحن, فئة موقع شحن, نوع موقع شحن, مستند استلام أمر تشغيل, مستند نقل أمر تشغيل, مستند تسليم أمر تشغيل, حالة أمر تشغيل
- [E-Invoicing in the Freight Module](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-einvoicing.html) (ar: التعامل مع الفاتورة الإلكترونية في وحدة الشحن): The freight module's invoices plug into Nama ERP's e-invoicing framework exactly like ordinary sales invoices — they are Tax Authority Documents sent to the relevant authority (ZATCA in Saudi Arabia, the Egyptian Tax Authority, the UAE system…). - entities: FRMSalesInvoice, FRMServiceItem - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات خدمة, بند خدمة
- [International Postal System (IPS) — Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-postal-intro.html) (ar: نظام البريد الدولي (IPS) — نظرة عامة): Alongside freight and logistics, the Freight Management module includes a complete system for running International Postal System (IPS) operations. - entities: IPSMailClass, IPSMailCategory, IPSMailSubclass, IPSMailCondition, IPSParcelStatus, IPSDeliveryAndReceiptArea, IPSMailRetentionReason, IPSNonDeliveryReason, IPSNonDeliveryMeasure, IPSEvent - screens (ar): فئة بريد, تصنيف البريد, نوع البريد, حالة البريد, حالة الطرد, مكان تسليم واستلام, سبب تحقق البريد, سبب عدم التوصيل, إجراء عدم التسليم
- [Mail Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-mail-items.html) (ar: المواد البريدية): After the inbound receptacles are opened, the mail item becomes the focus of the work: it's recorded, transferred between offices, adjusted, stock-taken, and sorted for delivery. - entities: IPSMailItemManifest, IPSPostalParcelsSort, IPSMailItemTransfer, IPSMailItemAdjustment, IPSMailItemStockTaking, IPSMailRetentionDocument - screens (ar): مستند تجميع مواد, فرز الطرد توصيل / تخزين, سند تحويل بين المكاتب, سند تسوية شحنة, سند تفريغ المخزن للجرد وإعادة التخزين, مذكرة تحقيق بريد
- [Receptacles](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-receptacles.html) (ar: الأكياس البريدية (Receptacles)): A receptacle is the transport container that gathers several mail items for movement between offices — a sealed bag or box. - entities: IPSReceptaclesReceipt, IPSManifestForCustody, IPSTransferReceptacles - screens (ar): استلام الكيس, منافيست للجمرك, مستند إرسال الاكياس جدول الطريق
- [Delivery Service](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-delivery.html) (ar: خدمة التوصيل (Delivery)): The final stage in a mail item's journey: delivering it to the customer and collecting the service value and any customs fees. - entities: IPSDeliveryRequest, IPSDeliveryInvoice, IPSDeliveryServiceItem, IPSDeliveryServicePrice - screens (ar): طلب توصيل, فاتورة توصيل, بند خدمة توصيل, ملف أسعار خدمة توصيل
- [IPS Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع نظام IPS (IPS Integration)): Connecting the freight module's postal documents to the IPS international postal system: the IPS settings, look-ups that fill receptacle and mail item lines, and the events reported on save. - entities: IPSEvent, IPSReceptaclesReceipt, IPSTransferReceptacles, IPSMailItemManifest, IPSManifestForCustody, IPSMailRetentionDocument, IPSMailItemTransfer, IPSMailItemStockTaking, IPSMailItemAdjustment, IPSPostalParcelsSort - screens (ar): استلام الكيس, مستند إرسال الاكياس جدول الطريق, مستند تجميع مواد, منافيست للجمرك, مذكرة تحقيق بريد, سند تحويل بين المكاتب, سند تفريغ المخزن للجرد وإعادة التخزين, سند تسوية شحنة, فرز الطرد توصيل / تخزين
- [Freight Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات وحدة الشحن (Freight Configuration)): The freight module keeps a short list of module-wide settings in one screen: which service item to fall back on when a price-list line carries none, how storage locations are suggested and checked... - menu: Freight Management System → Settings → Freight Management System Settings
- [Freight Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الشحن (Freight Document Terms)): Every freight and postal document is saved under a document term, and the term is where the document's behaviour is decided: which accounts it books to, which status it stamps on the operation order, which postal event it reports... - entities: DocumentTerm, FRMSalesInvoice, FRMSalesReturn, FRMSalesOrder, FRMPurchaseInvoice, FRMPurchaseReturn, FRMOperationOrder, FRMOOReceipt, FRMOOTransfer, FRMOODelivery, IPSDeliveryRequest, IPSDeliveryInvoice, IPSMailItemManifest, IPSMailItemTransfer, IPSMailItemStockTaking, IPSMailItemAdjustment, IPSManifestForCustody, IPSMailRetentionDocument, IPSPostalParcelsSort, IPSReceptaclesReceipt, IPSTransferReceptacles - screens (ar): توجيه مستند, فاتورة مبيعات خدمة, مردود مبيعات خدمة, أمر بيع خدمة, فاتورة مشتريات خدمة, مردود مشتريات خدمة, أمر تشغيل, مستند استلام أمر تشغيل, مستند نقل أمر تشغيل, مستند تسليم أمر تشغيل, طلب توصيل, فاتورة توصيل, مستند تجميع مواد, سند تحويل بين المكاتب, سند تفريغ المخزن للجرد وإعادة التخزين, سند تسوية شحنة, منافيست للجمرك, مذكرة تحقيق بريد, فرز الطرد توصيل / تخزين, استلام الكيس, مستند إرسال الاكياس جدول الطريق - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Hospital Management System

- [Hospital Management System](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/) (ar: نظام إدارة المستشفيات): Overview of the Hospital Management module: the patient journey from registration and admission through medical services to the closing invoice, split billing between patient and insurer, licensing, and how the guide is organized.
- [Hospital Management System Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات نظام إدارة المستشفيات): The Hospital Management System Settings screen: how the check-in and check-out options turn a stay into billable days, which discount, tax and price-classifier fields the hospital screens show, and when a change takes effect. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Hospital Management System → Settings → Hospital Management System Settings
- [Hospital Structure & Rooms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-facility.html) (ar: هيكل المستشفى والغرف): Before you admit your first patient, you need to map your building inside the system: which buildings you have, their floors and sections, which rooms and beds they hold, and which clinics operate. - entities: HMSRoom, HMSRoomClassification, HMSBed, HMSSection, HMSBuilding, HMSFloor, HMSClinic, HMSRoomDegree - screens (ar): غرفة مستشفى, تصنيف غرفة, سرير, قسم طبى, مبنى مستشفى, طابق مستشفى, عيادة, درجة الغرفة - menu: Hospital Management System → Hospital Structure → HMS Room
- [Medical Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-medical-master-files.html) (ar: الملفات الطبية الأساسية): Having mapped the building, we now define the staff and medical concepts that the documents work with every day: doctors, specialties, diseases, medical services, analyzers, feeding, and patient classes. - entities: HMSDoctor, HMSMedicalService, HMSMedicalSpecialty, HMSMedServiceCategory, HMSDisease, HMSAntibiotic, HMSMedicalDevice, HMSFeedingType, HMSPatientClass, HMSDocumentCategory, HMSProcedureType - screens (ar): طبيب, الخدمة الطبية, تخصص طبي, تصنيف خدمات طبية, مرض, مضاد حيوى, جهاز تحليل, نوع تغذية, فئة مريض, تصنيف طبى, نوع الإجراء - menu: Hospital Management System → Master Files → Doctor
- [Medical Service Catalog](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-service-catalog.html) (ar: كتالوج الخدمات الطبية): Alongside general medical services, the hospital keeps specialized catalogs for each kind of clinical activity: lab tests, radiology, physiotherapy, and surgeries. - entities: HMSLabTestType, HMSRadiologyType, HMSSurgeryType, HMSPhysicalTherapyType, HMSSurgeryPackage, HMSPackageItem, HMSLabTestCategory, HMSRadiologyCategory, HMSPhyTherapyCategory, HMSSurgeryClassification, HMSTest, HMSTestTube, HMSTestTubeColor - screens (ar): نوع تحليل طبي, نوع أشعة, نوع عملية جراحية, نوع العلاج الطبيعى, اتفاق عملية, بند اتفاق عملية, تصنيف تحليل طبى, تصنيف أشعة, تصنيف علاج طبيعى, تصنيف عملية جراحية, اختبار, أنبوبة اختبار, لون أنبوبة الإختبار - menu: Hospital Management System → Laboratory Tests → Laboratory Test Type
- [Medical Insurance & Approvals](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-insurance.html) (ar: التأمين الطبي والموافقات): Setting up medical insurance: insurance companies and their classes, and the Insurance Company Approval that sets the agreed service prices and how each is split between the patient's and the insurer's share. - entities: InsuranceCompanyApproval, HMSInsuranceCompany, HMSInsuranceClass, HMSInsuranceCompanyClass - screens (ar): موافقة شركة تأمين, شركة تأمين طبى, فئة تأمين, فئة شركة تأمين طبى - menu: Hospital Management System → Master Files → Insurance Company Approval
- [Pricing, Costing & Discounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-pricing.html) (ar: الأسعار والتكاليف والخصومات): HMS pricing screens: Medical Sales Price List, Medical Cost List, Medical Discount, the overhead items, lists and Actual Overhead Calculation, and Change Patient Price Plan. - entities: HMSSalesPriceList, HMSCostList, HMSDiscount, HMSOverheadItem, HMSOverheadList, HMSActualOverheadCalculation, HMSChangePatientPricePlan - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار طبية, قائمة تكاليف طبية, خصم طبى, بند تكاليف طبية غير مباشرة, قائمة تكاليف طبية غير مباشرة, سند حساب التكلفة الطبية الغير مباشرة الفعلية, تغيير خطة أسعار مريض - menu: Hospital Management System → Master Files → Medical Sales Price List
- [Patients & Admission](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-patients.html) (ar: المرضى والدخول): The hospital patient file, outpatient reservations and clinic schedules, admitting an inpatient through the Patient Admission form, and recording diagnosis and health status. - entities: HMSPatient, HMSPatientAdmission, HMSOutpatientReservation, HMSOutpatientSchedule, HMSPatientDiagnosis, HMSPatientHealthStatus, HMSQuestionnaireTemplate, HMSQuestion - screens (ar): مريض, إستمارة دخول مريض, حجز العيادة الخارجية, موعد عيادة خارجية, سند تشخيص مريض, الحالة الصحية للمريض, قالب اسئلة حالة صحية, سؤال حالة صحية - menu: Hospital Management System → Master Files → Patient

- [HR Calendar, Holidays & Weekends](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/setup/hr-calendar-and-holidays.html) (ar: تقويم الموارد البشرية والعطلات وأيام الراحة الأسبوعية): Setting up the HR Calendar, HR Holidays and weekly rest days, which are set on the Attendance Plan, and how together they decide the working days used by attendance, vacation-day counts and payroll. - entities: HRCalendar, HRHolidays - screens (ar): تقويم الرواتب, عطلة رسمية
- [Employee HR Information](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/setup/employee-hr-information.html) (ar: معلومات شئون الموظف): The Employee HR Information master file in Payroll, which holds each employee's salary structure, calendar and personal salary component lines, and the Employment Information screen for bulk onboarding. - entities: EmployeeHRInfo, EmployementInformation - screens (ar): معلومات شئون الموظفين, بيان توظيف - menu: Payroll → Main → Employee HR Information

#### Payroll

- [Payroll](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/) (ar: الرواتب)
- [Salary Components](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/salary-components.html) (ar: مفردات الراتب (Salary Components)): How payslip elements are defined: the Salary Component Type and the flags its components inherit, the Salary Component with who it applies to and its account lines, and the Salary Component Group, plus the screen actions and messages. - entities: SalaryComponent, SalaryComponentType, SalaryComponentGroup - screens (ar): مفرد راتب, نوع المفرد, مجموعة مفردات راتب
- [Salary Calculation Formulas](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/salary-calculation-formulas.html) (ar: معادلات حساب الراتب (Salary Calculation Formulas)): A Salary Component set to Variable Value doesn't carry a number of its own — it carries a Component Calculation Formula, which is the recipe that turns that month's inputs into a figure. - entities: ComponentCalcFormula, DailySalary - screens (ar): معادلة حساب المفرد, أجر يومى - menu: Payroll → Salary Configurations → Component Calculation Formula
- [Salary Structures](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/salary-structures.html) (ar: هياكل الراتب (Salary Structures)): The Salary Structure screen: a reusable template of salary component types with values or formulas, its fields and components grid, the fallback rule versus employee components, and where structures are used. - entities: SalaryStructure - screens (ar): هيكل راتب - menu: Payroll → Salary Configurations → Salary Structure
- [Salary Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/salary-documents.html) (ar: مستندات الرواتب (Salary Documents)): The Salary Sheet batch run for a payroll period, the Salary Document payslip it generates per employee, the Salary Generation Range, how employees are collected, and the accounting effect. - entities: SalarySheet, SalaryDocument, SalaryGenerationRange - screens (ar): سجل الرواتب, سند الراتب, مجال اصدار الرواتب
- [Annual Increases](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/hr-annual-increases.html) (ar: الزيادات السنوية (Annual Increases)): The Annual Increases Document for a raise round: its period and employee scope, the rule for which salary components rise and by how much, its workflow and the per-employee changes it generates. - entities: AnnualIncreasesDoc - screens (ar): مستند الزياده السنوية - menu: Payroll → Main → Annual Increases Document
- [Salary Blocking & Partial Payment](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/payroll/salary-blocking.html) (ar: حجب الرواتب والصرف الجزئي (Salary Blocking & Partial Payment)): How to hold and release an employee's pay: the Salary Block Rule that holds pay automatically, the Salary Block and Salary UnBlock documents, and Partial Salary Payment templates for paying out only part of a salary. - entities: SalaryBlockRule, SalaryBlockDocument, SalaryUnBlockDocument, PartialSalaryPayment - screens (ar): قاعدة حجب مرتب, حجب راتب موظف, إلغاء حجب راتب, ملف صرف راتب جزئي

#### Document Terms

- [Document Terms (Modules › Human Resources)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات المستندات)
- [Salary and Dues Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/hr-terms-salary-and-dues.html) (ar: توجيهات الرواتب والتصفية): How HR document terms work, and what the terms of the salary document, salary sheet, daily salary, dues liquidation, annual increases and employee provisions documents control: accounts, accounting effect and document behaviour. - entities: SalaryDocument, SalarySheet, DailySalary, DuesLiquidationDoc, AggrDuesLiquidationDoc, AnnualIncreasesDoc, EmployeeProvisionsOpening, EmployeeProvisionsRecalc, AggrEmpProvisionsRecalc - screens (ar): سند الراتب, سجل الرواتب, أجر يومى, مستند تصفية مستحقات, سند تصفية مستحقات مجمعة, مستند الزياده السنوية, سند إفتتاحي مخصصات موظف, سند إعادة احتساب مخصصات موظف, سند إعادة احتساب مخصصات موظف مجمع - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Attendance and Vacation Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/hr-terms-attendance-and-vacations.html) (ar: توجيهات الحضور والإجازات): Vacation and attendance documents rarely create an accounting entry by themselves — a vacation does not move money, it moves a balance, and the money follows later on a salary document. - entities: VacationDocument, AggregatedVacationDocument, AggregatedVacationStartingDoc, MultiEmpVacation, VacationCompensation, AggregatedVacationCompensation, AggregatedLeavePermission, AggregatedMissionDocument, HolidaysRestBalanceDoc - screens (ar): سند أجازة, سند أجازه مجمع, سند مباشرة عمل أجازة مجمعة, سند أجازة مجمع لأكثر من موظف, سند صرف بدل أجازة, صرف بدل أجازة مجمع, إذن انصراف مجمع, سند مأموريه مجمع, بدل أرصده راحات أسبوعية و عطلات رسمية - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Loan, Reward and Penalty Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/hr-terms-loans-rewards-and-penalties.html) (ar: توجيهات السلف والمكافآت والجزاءات): These documents all move money that is not salary — an advance paid out, an instalment collected, a bonus granted, a fine deducted — so unlike the vacation family, most of them have an accounting effect, and their terms are mostly about accounts. - entities: HRLoanDocument, AggHRLoanDocument, HRLoanPaymentDocument, HRLoanReliefDocument, AggHRLoanInstallReschedule, RewardAndPenaltieDocument, AggrRewardAndPenaltieDoc, HOPenaltyDocument - screens (ar): سند سلفة, سند سلفة مجمعة, سند سداد سلفة, سند أعفاء سلفة, سند إعادة جدولة أقساط سلفة مجمع, سند مكافأة/جزاء, سند مكافأه - جزاء مجمع, سند مخالفة - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Employment and Government Relations Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/hr-terms-employment-and-government.html) (ar: توجيهات التوظيف والعلاقات الحكومية): These are the documents that change who somebody is rather than what they are paid: the offer that hires them, the update that changes their salary or their department, the relocation, the termination, and — in the Gulf countries — the residence... - entities: JobOffer, CandidateJobOffer, UpdateEmployeeInfo, AggrUpdateEmpInfo, EmployeeRelocate, AggFiringDocument, AggFiringRequest, HODefinitionLetter, AggrResidenceRenewReq, AggrHOSponsorshipTransferDoc, AggrHOExitReEntryVisaReq - screens (ar): عرض وظيفي, عرض وظيفي لمتقدم للعمل, تحديث بيانات الموظف, سند تحديث بيانات موظف مجمع, سند نقل موظف, سند إنهاء خدمة مجمع, طلب إنهاء خدمة مجمعة, خطاب تعريف موظف, طلب تجديد إقامة مجمع, طلب نقل كفالة مجمع, طلب تأشيرة خروج وعودة مجمع - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Insurance Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/document-terms/hr-terms-insurance.html) (ar: توجيهات التأمينات): The document terms of the employee health insurance and car insurance documents: the accounts, tax and accounting switches each term carries, and what each health insurance document adds to their shared term layout. - entities: EmployeeHealthInsurance, HealthInsuranceUpgrade, EmpHealthInsurDelete, HealthInsuranceClaimDoc, HealthInsuranceCredence, CarInsurancePolicy, CarInsuranceAddingDoc, CarInsuranceRemovingDoc, CarInsuranceInstallmentProofDoc - screens (ar): سند إضافة موظف للتأمين, سند ترقية تأمين, سند حذف تأمين موظف, سند تعويض طبي, سند تعميد شركة تأمين, بوليصة تأمين سيارات, سند إضافة تأمين سيارات, سند حذف سيارات من التأمين, قيد إثبات استحقاق قسط تأمين السيارة - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

- [Leave Permissions & Missions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/attendance/leave-permissions-and-missions.html) (ar: الاستئذانات والمأموريات (Leave Permissions & Missions)): Leave Permission and Mission Document for short intra-day absences, the Leave Permission Configuration limits, the Leave Reason list, mission overlaps, and the aggregated versions for many employees. - entities: LeavePermission, MissionDocument, AggregatedLeavePermission, AggregatedMissionDocument, LeavePermissionConfiguration, LeaveReason - screens (ar): إذن إنصراف, سند مأمورية, إذن انصراف مجمع, سند مأموريه مجمع, إعدادات إذن الانصراف, نوع سبب
- [Overtime and Lateness](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/attendance/overtime-and-lateness.html) (ar: الوقت الإضافي والتأخير): How HR attendance measures overtime, lateness, early leave and missing punches from punches and shifts, how days off and holidays are handled, and the settings that change each result. - entities: TimeAttendance, AttendancePlan, PerformanceIndicator - screens (ar): حضور / إنصراف, خطة الدوام, مؤشر الأداء

#### Loans & Installments

- [Loan Adjustments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/loans/hr-loan-adjustments.html) (ar: تسويات السلف): Once a Loan Document is running, three separate screens change it without touching the original disbursement: writing part of the balance off, moving installments around in time, and pausing (or resuming) the whole loan. - entities: HRLoanReliefDocument, HRLoanInstallReschedule, HRLoanDisableDocument - screens (ar): سند أعفاء سلفة, سند إعاده جدوله اقساط سلفه, سند تعطيل سلفة

#### Government Relations

- [Government Relations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/) (ar: العلاقات الحكومية)
- [Government Relations Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/government-relations-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على العلاقات الحكومية (Government Relations Overview)): Overview of the Gulf government relations documents (residency, visas, GOSI): their shared cycle, the Transaction Type fee catalogue, the Definition Letter, and the Payment Request for government fees. - entities: HOTransactionType, HODefinitionLetter, HOPaymentRequest - screens (ar): نوع معاملة, خطاب تعريف موظف, طلب سداد مدفوعات
- [HR Visas](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/hr-visas.html) (ar: التأشيرات (HR Visas)): Recording Gulf visa procedures for expatriate employees: exit / re-entry visas, single or in a batch, and their extension, final-exit and family-visit visas, passport delivery, and how each visa's end date is calculated. - entities: HOExitReEntryVisaReq, AggrHOExitReEntryVisaReq, HOExtendingVisaReq, HOFinalExitVisaReq, HOFamilyVisitVisaRequest, HOPassportDeliveringReq - screens (ar): طلب تأشيرة خروج وعودة, طلب تأشيرة خروج وعودة مجمع, طلب تمديد تاشيرة الخروج والعودة, طلب تاشيرة خروج نهائي, طلب زيارة عائليه, طلب استلام جواز سفر
- [Residence Renewal](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/residence-renewal.html) (ar: تجديد الإقامة (Residence Renewal)): Renewing an employee's Iqama with the Residence Renew Request: the renewal period and new end date, the fee breakdown, writing the new dates back to the employee, and renewing a whole batch with the Aggregated Residence Renew Request. - entities: ResidenceRenewReq, AggrResidenceRenewReq - screens (ar): طلب تجديد إقامة, طلب تجديد إقامة مجمع - menu: Human Resources → ADMINISTRATIVE TRANSACTIONS → Residence Renew Request
- [Visa Pool](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/visa-pool.html) (ar: مجمع التأشيرات (Visa Pool)): Managing the company's pool of Gulf hiring visas: recording the quota with Issued Visas, allocating part of it to a PRO office with Visas Delegation, spending it with Visa Handling, and registering the hire's arrival with Employee Advent Registeration. - entities: HRIssuedVisas, HRVisasDelegation, HRVisaHandling, HREmpAdventRegisteration - screens (ar): تأشيرات صادرة, تفويض تاشيرة, منح تأشيرة, تسجيل قدوم موظف
- [Social Insurance & Sponsorship](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/social-insurance-and-sponsorship.html) (ar: التأمينات الاجتماعية والكفالة): Two of the most sensitive government touch-points for an expatriate workforce are the GOSI social insurance register and the sponsorship (Kafala) relationship. - entities: HOEmpSocialInsuranceAdd, HOEmpSocialInsuranceRemove, HOSponsorshipTransferDoc, AggrHOSponsorshipTransferDoc - screens (ar): سند إضافة موظفين للتأمينات الإجتماعية, سند حذف موظفين من التأمينات الإجتماعية, طلب نقل كفالة موظف, طلب نقل كفالة مجمع
- [Government Penalties](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/government-penalties.html) (ar: الجزاءات الحكومية): Alongside the visa and fee work, the government-relations desk maintains the company's disciplinary code — the internal list of workplace violations and the penalties attached to them — and issues the documents that apply a penalty to an employee. - entities: HOViolationItem, HOViolationList, HOPenaltyDocument, HOPenaltyRequest - screens (ar): بند مخالفة, مادة لائحة إدارية, سند مخالفة, طلب مخالفة

### Point of Sale

- [Point of Sale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/) (ar: نقاط البيع): Landing page for Nama POS, the offline-first desktop register with the Captain Order waiter app: how the guide is organised, from installing a register and selling to server-side setup.
- [Nama POS — Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-overview.html) (ar: نقاط البيع (Nama POS) — نظرة عامة): Overview of Nama POS: the offline-first desktop register, the Captain Order mobile app, the central ERP side where registers and permissions are set up, and what can be done at the register.
- [Installing Nama POS on a New Register and Connecting It to the Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-installation.html) (ar: تنزيل نقاط البيع على ماكينة جديدة وربطها بالخادم الرئيسي): Nama POS is a desktop application that runs right on the cash register and keeps its own local database, so it can keep selling even when the connection to the central server drops.
- [Getting Started at the Register](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-getting-started.html) (ar: البداية على الماكينة): This page walks through the everyday basics: starting the application, signing in, finding your way around the menu, locking the screen when you step away, and switching language or theme. - entities: POSSecurityProfile, NamaPOSShortcuts - screens (ar): صلاحيات نقاط البيع, اختصارات نقطة البيع
- [The Sales Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-sales-invoice.html) (ar: فاتورة المبيعات): The POS sales screen: its layout and every button on its tabs, header and lines, and the everyday flow of ringing up a sale, from adding items and discounts to setting the customer and getting ready to pay. - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات نقاط البيع - menu: Point of sale → Documents → POS Sales Invoice
- [Payment & Tender](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-payment-and-tender.html) (ar: الدفع والتحصيل): The POS tender screen and every way a customer can pay: cash, card, split payments, deferred payment, credit notes and coupons, and reward points, plus the money rules worth knowing and the receipt. - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات نقاط البيع
- [Returns & Replacements](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-returns-and-replacements.html) (ar: المرتجعات والإحلال): POS sales returns (full or partial, with or without the original invoice, return reasons and wear deductions), replacements, credit notes and discount coupons, with the messages a cashier may see. - entities: NamaPOSSalesReturn, NamaPOSSalesReplacement, NamaPOSCreditNote - screens (ar): مردود نقاط البيع, إستبدال مبيعات نقاط البيع, إشعار دائن نقاط البيع
- [Shifts & Cash](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-shifts-and-cash.html) (ar: الورديات والنقدية): A shift is one work session on a register: it opens when a cashier starts, and closes when they count down the drawer and hand over. - entities: POSShiftOpening, POSShiftClosing, POSReceiptFromRegister, POSPaymentToRegister - screens (ar): فتح ورديه, غلق وردية, مقبوض نقاط البيع, مصروف نقاط البيع
- [Tables, Reservations & Captain Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-tables-and-restaurant.html) (ar: الطاولات والحجوزات وكابتن أوردر): Restaurant service at the POS: halls and tables and their statuses, table reservations, suspended orders and the call-center flow, online orders, and the Captain Order mobile app for waiters. - entities: NamaPOSHall, NamaPOSTable, NamaPOSOrderReservation, NamaPOSCancelReservation - screens (ar): صالة نقاط البيع, طاولة نقاط البيع, سند حجز اوردر نقاط بيع, سند إلغاء حجز اوردر نقاط بيع
- [Self-Checkout Kiosk](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-self-checkout-kiosk.html) (ar: كشك الدفع الذاتي (Self-Checkout Kiosk)): A self-checkout kiosk lets shoppers scan their own items and pay by card without a cashier.
- [Item Add-ons](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-item-addons.html) (ar: إضافات الأصناف): Item add-ons at the POS: the POS Item Additional Items setup that offers up to ten groups of choices when an item is added, with single or multiple, required and default choices. - entities: NamaPosItemAdditionalItems - screens (ar): الأصناف الإضافية للصنف في نقاط البيع - menu: Point of sale → Settings → POS Item Additional Items
- [Inventory Operations at the Register](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-inventory-operations.html) (ar: العمليات المخزنية على الماكينة): The stock documents a shop user creates at the register: stock receipt, stock transfer request, stock taking, and scrap and shortfalls documents for damaged or missing stock. - entities: NamaPOSStockReceipt, NamaPOSStockTransferReq, NamaPOSStockTakingDetails, NamaPOSScrapDoc, NamaPOSShortfallsDoc - screens (ar): توريد نقاط البيع, طلب تحويل مخزني نقاط البيع, لجنة جرد نقط بيع, مستند الهوالك, مستند النواقص
- [Reports & Tools](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-reports-and-tools.html) (ar: التقارير والأدوات): Beyond selling, the register carries a handful of everyday tools: running reports, messaging other staff, checking a price without making a sale, and — for supervisors — running maintenance utilities. - entities: NamaPOSInternalMessage - screens (ar): رسالة نقاط بيع داخليه
- [How POS Data Syncs with the Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-data-sync.html) (ar: كيف تتزامن بيانات نقاط البيع مع الخادم): How a POS register works on its own local database and syncs with the central Nama ERP: unsent versus sent documents, working online or offline, and what to do when a document will not go up to the server.

#### Server-Side Setup

- [Server-Side Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/) (ar: الإعداد على الخادم): Landing page for POS server-side setup: the register master file, POS Settings and the supporting screens that control warehouses, numbering, shift closing, accounts and cashier permissions.
- [Setting Up a Register](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-register-setup.html) (ar: إعداد الماكينة (Register)): Every machine that runs Nama POS is described on the server by one Register record (ماكينة). - entities: NamaPOSRegister, NamaPOSHall, NamaPOSTable - screens (ar): صالة نقاط البيع, طاولة نقاط البيع - menu: Point of sale → Register → Register

- [Numbering POS Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-document-numbering.html) (ar: ترقيم مستندات نقاط البيع): How each POS register numbers its own documents while offline: the parts of a document code, the prefix, digits and date settings in the register's coding grid, where a sequence starts, and the related messages. - entities: NamaPOSRegister - screens (ar): ماكينة - menu: Point of sale → Register → Register
- [Shift Opening, Closing & Cash-Reset Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-shift-close-settings.html) (ar: إعدادات فتح وغلق الوردية وتصفير النقدية): What POS shift openings and closings become on the server: resetting the cash at close and why it may not happen, how cash differences reach the accounts, and the settings and payment-method options that shape the close. - entities: POSShiftOpening, POSShiftClosing, POSCashDrawer - screens (ar): فتح ورديه, غلق وردية, جرد - menu: Point of sale → Documents → POS Shift Closing
- [POS Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات نقاط البيع): How the server picks the book and term for each document a POS register sends, using the register's Books And Terms and term grids, the error term, and what each POS term screen controls. - entities: DocumentTerm, NamaPOSRegister - screens (ar): توجيه مستند, ماكينة
- [POS Security Profiles](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-security-profiles.html) (ar: صلاحيات نقاط البيع (POS Security Profile)): The POS Security Profile screen that controls what a cashier may do at the register: attaching users, checkboxes versus the capabilities grid, supervisor approval instead of refusal, and every permission. - entities: POSSecurityProfile - menu: Point of sale → Settings → POS Security Profile
- [Service Charge, Minimum Charge, Delivery & Return Reasons](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-charges-and-returns-settings.html) (ar: الخدمة السياحية والحد الأدنى للطلب والتوصيل وأسباب الإرجاع): Setting up the POS service charge, delivery charge and minimum charge on the server, each with its item and settings record, plus the return reasons and depreciation reasons cashiers pick from when goods come back. - entities: POSServiceChargeSettings, PosMinChargeSettings, NamaPOSDeliveryCost, NamaPOSDepreciationReason, NamaPOSReturnReason - screens (ar): إعدادات الخدمة السياحية في نقاط البيع, إعدادات الحد الأدنى للطلب في نقاط البيع, تكاليف خدمة توصيل نقاط البيع, سبب الهالك, سبب الإرجاع
- [What a Register Receives: Items, Barcodes & Sync Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-items-and-sync-settings.html) (ar: ما الذي تستلمه الماكينة: الأصناف والباركود وإعدادات المزامنة): The server screens that shape what a POS register receives: which items it gets, stock checks, the item barcode parser for scale and GS1 barcodes, documents that must reach the server first, extra search filters, the read queue and the update statement runner. - entities: NaMaPosItemsToSend, NamaPOSItemQtyUpdateConfig, NamaPOSItemBarcodeParser, NamaPOSReadQueuePriorityConfig, NamaPOSInvSavingSettings, NamaPOSExtraFilter, NamaPOSDBUpdateStatement - screens (ar): الأصناف المرسلة لنقاط البيع, إعدادات تحديث كميات الماكينة, مواصفات باركود أصناف نقاط البيع, إعدادات أولوية نقل البيانات للماكينة, إعدادات الحفظ في نقاط البيع, Filters إضافية لنقطة البيع
- [Screen, Keyboard & Device Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-screen-and-device-settings.html) (ar: إعدادات الشاشة ولوحة المفاتيح والأجهزة): The POS settings records that shape what the cashier sees and types: screen layouts, the waiter's phone, keyboard shortcuts, pole display, default values, required fields, phone country codes and payment methods. - entities: NamaPosUISettings, NamaPosMobileUISettings, NamaPOSShortcuts, NamaPosPoleDisplaySpecs, NamaPosDefaultsTemplate, NamaPosRequiredFields, NamaPOSCustomerPhoneCountryCodes, NamaPOSPaymentMethodsSettings, PaymentFromPosSettings - screens (ar): إعدادات واجهة نقاط البيع الجديده, إعدادات واجهة نقاط البيع للموبايل, اختصارات نقطة البيع, خصائص ال Pole Display لنقاط البيع, قالب قيم افتراضيه لنقاط البيع, الحقول المطلوبه لنقاط البيع, أكواد الدول لأرقام عملاء نقاط البيع, إعدادات طرق دفع نقاط البيع, إعدادات دفع من خلال نقاط البيع
- [POS Documents on the Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-documents-on-the-server.html) (ar: مستندات نقاط البيع على الخادم): Everything a cashier does at the register — a sale, a refund, a pay-out, a stock count — is saved on the register first and then synced up to Nama ERP as a document (see How POS Data Syncs with the Server). - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice, NamaPOSSalesReturn, NamaPOSSalesReplacement, NamaPOSHeldInvoice, NamaPOSReturnPeriodExtension, NamaPOSOrderReservation, NamaPOSCancelReservation, POSPaymentToRegister, POSReceiptFromRegister, NamaPOSStockTransferReq, NamaPOSStockTakingDetails, NamaPOSStockReceipt, NamaPOSShortfallsDoc, NamaPOSScrapDoc, NamaPOSCreditNote, NamaPOSInternalMessage, NamaPOSGenericReference, NamaPOSAggGenericReference - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات نقاط البيع, مردود نقاط البيع, إستبدال مبيعات نقاط البيع, فاتورة معلقة, سند تمديد فترة إرجاع مبيعات نقاط البيع, سند حجز اوردر نقاط بيع, سند إلغاء حجز اوردر نقاط بيع, مصروف نقاط البيع, مقبوض نقاط البيع, طلب تحويل مخزني نقاط البيع, لجنة جرد نقط بيع, توريد نقاط البيع, مستند النواقص, مستند الهوالك, إشعار دائن نقاط البيع, رسالة نقاط بيع داخليه, المرجع العام لنقاط البيع, المرجع العام المجمع لنقاط البيع

#### Sales

- [Sales](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/) (ar: المبيعات)
- [The Property Sales Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-sales-cycle.html) (ar: دورة بيع العقار): The chain of real estate sales documents from offer to handover, which step takes a unit off the market or moves money in the ledger, and the Sales Offer and Temporary Reservation screens in detail. - entities: RESalesOffer, RETempReservation - screens (ar): عرض سعر بيع, حجز مؤقت
- [Price Lists and Payment Plan Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-price-lists-and-payment-methods.html) (ar: قوائم الأسعار ونماذج الدفع): The Real Estate sales price list, how a unit price is matched and made binding, and the payment method template that fills a sales contract's down payment and installment plan. - entities: RESalesPriceList, RESalesPaymentMethod - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار استثمار عقاري, نموذج دفع بيع عقار
- [Reservations and Initial Sales Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-reservations-and-initial-contracts.html) (ar: الحجوزات وعقود البيع المبدئية): The Real Estate reservation document and its statuses, turning it into a contract, the reservation cancellation, and the initial (preliminary) sales contract that locks a unit with no accounting entry. - entities: REReservationDoc, REReservationDocCancel, REInitialSalesContract - screens (ar): مستند حجز استثمار عقاري, سند إلغاء حجز استثمار عقاري, عقد بيع مبدئي
- [The Sales Contract](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-sales-contract.html) (ar: عقد البيع): The real estate Sales Contract: filling its blocks and commissions grid, what committing it does to the unit and the receivable, its journal entry including advance income and installment tax, contracts versus extensions, and its validations. - entities: RESalesDoc - screens (ar): عقد بيع - menu: Real Estate and Property → Sales → Sales Contract
- [Building the Installment Plan](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-installment-plans.html) (ar: إنشاء خطة الأقساط): The installment plan on Real Estate sales documents: the price block, the installment construction block, the installment grid column by column, creating and merging installments, and installment types. - entities: RESalesDoc - screens (ar): عقد بيع
- [Handing the Unit Over](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-handover.html) (ar: تسليم الوحدة): The Estate Handover document that records delivery and can release the contract's accounting, the Inspection Document for the unit's condition, and Post Handover Cost for cost arriving after handover. - entities: REEStateHandover, REInspectionDoc, PostHandoverCost - screens (ar): تسليم وحدة, محضر استلام, تكلفة ما بعد التسليم
- [Waivers and Cancelling a Sale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/sales/realestate-waiver-and-cancellation.html) (ar: التنازل وفسخ عقد البيع): How to undo a Real Estate sale: the Waiver Document and its two types, waiver price and accounting, cancelling or deleting a wrong contract, and what the Cancel Contract Request does. - entities: REWaiverDoc, RECancelContractReq - screens (ar): سند تنازل عن ملكية, طلب فسخ تعاقد - menu: Real Estate and Property → Documents → Waiver Document

#### Rent

- [Rent](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/) (ar: الإيجارات)
- [The Leasing Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-cycle.html) (ar: دورة التأجير): Map of the Real Estate leasing cycle: the Renter field, the Rental Contract term flag, the chain from rent offer to contract, accrual, collection and renewal or termination, and the estate rent-status timeline. - entities: RERentContract, RERentOffer, RERentOfferCancel, REMultiRentContract, REOpeningRentContract, RERentInstallmentLedger, RECancelContract - screens (ar): عقد إيجار, عرض سعر ايجار, إلغاء حجز عرض سعر إيجار, سند عقود مجمعة, عقد ايجار افتتاحي, قيد إثبات استحقاق قسط إيجار, انهاء عقد ايجار
- [Rent Offers and Reserving a Unit for Rent](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-offers.html) (ar: عروض أسعار الإيجار وحجز الوحدة): The Rent offer, a priced quotation for one estate that can also reserve the unit, creating a rent contract from it, and the Rent offer Cancel document that releases the reservation. - entities: RERentOffer, RERentOfferCancel - screens (ar): عرض سعر ايجار, إلغاء حجز عرض سعر إيجار - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Rent offer
- [The Rent Contract](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-contract.html) (ar: عقد الإيجار): The Rent Contract screen page by page: contract values, the Rents payment schedule grid, fees, yearly discounts and increases, terms, what committing it does and its accounting entry, and the validations you will meet. - entities: RERentContract - screens (ar): عقد إيجار - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Rent Contract
- [Generating the Rent Schedule](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-schedule.html) (ar: إنشاء جدول الإيجارات): How the Create Rents button builds a rent contract's Rents grid: frequency, commission and insurance, yearly increases, water, maintenance and expense lines, taxes, Hijri leases and opening many leases at once. - entities: RERentContract, REMultiRentContract - screens (ar): عقد إيجار, سند عقود مجمعة
- [Rent Installment Accrual Ledgers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-accrual-ledger.html) (ar: قيود إثبات استحقاق أقساط الإيجار): How the Rent Installment Ledger recognises rent revenue period by period: generating it from the rent contract, how the schedule is cut into accrual documents, moving an installment's accrual date, and what happens when a lease ends early. - entities: RERentInstallmentLedger - screens (ar): قيد إثبات استحقاق قسط إيجار - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Rent Installment Ledger
- [Renewing and Ending a Lease](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/rent/realestate-rent-renewal-and-termination.html) (ar: تمديد عقد الإيجار وإنهاؤه): How a rent contract is renewed or ended: the Extend Contract button that creates a new contract for the next term, the Cancel Contract settlement document and what it computes, early termination, money still owing and the buttons on both screens. - entities: RECancelContract, RERentContract - screens (ar): انهاء عقد ايجار, عقد إيجار - menu: Real Estate and Property → Rents → Cancel Contract

#### Collections and Payments

- [Collections and Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/) (ar: التحصيل والمدفوعات)
- [How Installment Collection Works](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-collection-basics.html) (ar: كيف يتم تحصيل الأقساط): Every contract in the Real Estate module ends up as a schedule of money: a sales contract, an opening sales contract, a rent contract, an opening rent contract, a reservation and even a waiver all carry a grid of installments.
- [Collect Documents and Bulk Collection](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-collect-documents.html) (ar: سندات التحصيل والتحصيل المجمع): The Real Estate collect document, collect request and aggregated collect document: filling them in, collecting several contracts in one document, turning the collection into cash and an invoice, and running a monthly bulk collection across many contracts. - entities: RECollectDoc, RECollectReq, AggrRECollectDoc - screens (ar): سند تحصيل, طلب تحصيل, سند تحصيل مجمع
- [Paying Collected Money to the Bank or the Owner](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-collection-payouts.html) (ar: توريد المحصل للبنك أو للمالك): The Pay Request For Bank and Pay Request For Owner documents: how collected rent is deposited in the bank or paid to the landlord, and how the transferred-amount fields on each collect document stop the same money being paid out twice. - entities: REBankPay, REOwnerPay - screens (ar): طلب صرف للبنك, طلب صرف للمالك
- [Exemptions and Returning Money to the Buyer](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-exemptions-and-returns.html) (ar: الإعفاءات ورد المبالغ للمشتري): The Real Estate Exemption Document, which waives rent installments without cash, and the RE Return Payment Document, which pays money or rebates back to the buyer, with worked examples. - entities: REExemptionDoc, REReturnPaymentDoc - screens (ar): سند إعفاء إيجار, سند سداد عائد
- [Late-Payment Fines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/collections/realestate-fines.html) (ar: غرامات التأخير): Late-payment fines in Real Estate: the fine document and how its amount is set, billing and collecting it separately from the installment, raising a fine from the contract, fine types, generating fines automatically and the accounts they affect. - entities: REFineDoc, REFineDocType - screens (ar): سند غرامة, تصنيف الغرامة - menu: Real Estate and Property → Fines → Real state fine Doc

#### Real Estate Maintenance

- [Real Estate Maintenance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/maintenance/) (ar: صيانة العقارات)
- [Maintenance Deposits and Maintenance Funds](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/maintenance/realestate-maintenance-deposits-and-funds.html) (ar: ودائع الصيانة وصناديق الصيانة): The two maintenance money streams in Real Estate: the maintenance deposit agreed on the sales contract, collected as installment lines and the accounts it hits, the maintenance fund record and how units join it, and booking the return earned on the parked money. - entities: REMaintenanceFund, REMaintenanceDepositProfit, RESalesDoc - screens (ar): صندوق الصيانة العقاري, أرباح صندوق وديعة الصيانة, عقد بيع
- [Accruing the Annual Maintenance Charge](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/maintenance/realestate-maintenance-accrual.html) (ar: إثبات استحقاق الصيانة السنوية): The Maintenance Accrual document that splits a compound's annual maintenance budget over its units pro-rata by area: filling it, the three accrual bases and what happens when it is processed. - entities: REMaintenanceAccrual - menu: Real Estate and Property → Documents → Maintenance Accrual
- [Maintenance Requests and Expenses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/maintenance/realestate-maintenance-expenses.html) (ar: طلبات ومصروفات الصيانة): The Maintenance Expense Request and Maintenance Expense documents: authorising and booking maintenance spend, recharging the customer's share, paying the contractor and distributing the cost over units. - entities: REMaintenanceExpense, REMaintenanceExpenseRequest - screens (ar): مصروف صيانة, طلب مصروف صيانة - menu: Real Estate and Property → Documents → Maintenance Expense

### Contracting

- [Contracting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/) (ar: المقاولات): Landing page for Nama Contracting: the project-owner and subcontractor sides of the module, the rule that contracts book nothing and extracts book everything, and links to every page from setup and estimating through contracts, costs and site records.
- [Contracting Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contracting-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على المقاولات): Overview of the Contracting module: the project-owner and subcontractor sides, why only extracts reach the ledger, the five menu groups, the two licences, the setup order on a new installation and the Tower A example used across the guide.
- [Contracting Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contracting-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات المقاولات): The Contracting module keeps its settings in a single record, and that record shapes the behaviour of every contract, extract and cost document in the database. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings

- [Contract Conditions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-conditions.html) (ar: الشروط التعاقدية): Every construction contract carries clauses that move money without being work: retain 5% of each payment until final handover, recover the mobilisation advance at 20% of every certificate, deduct 1,000 per day of delay... - entities: ContractingCondition, ContractingConditionsGroup - screens (ar): شرط قياسي, مجموعة الشروط القياسية - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Condition
- [Contracting Price Lists](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-price-lists.html) (ar: قوائم أسعار المقاولات): How to set up Contracting Price Lists (rate cards per customer and currency), publish or withdraw them, and how priority decides which list fills the rate on a term line. - entities: ContractingPriceList - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار المقاولات - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Price list
- [Phases and Work Areas](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-phases-and-work-areas.html) (ar: المراحل ومناطق العمل): Contracting phases, phase groups and work areas: how phases mark milestones on a line of work and their five-slot limit, how a phase group serves as a progress-billing template for term lines, and how work areas record where on site the work is. - entities: ContractingPhase, ContractingPhasesGroup, ContrWorkArea - screens (ar): مرحلة مقاولة, مجموعة مراحل, منطقة عمل مقاولات
- [Contract Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-contract-templates.html) (ar: نماذج العقود): The Contract Template master file: saving a priced term tree, its clauses and its cost build-up once, rolling cost back down to term prices, and how selecting a template on a new contract copies its terms. - entities: ContractTemplate - screens (ar): نموذج عقد مقاولات - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contract Template
- [Contractors and Consultants](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-contractors-and-consultants.html) (ar: المقاولون والاستشاريون): The Subcontractor and Consultant master files in Contracting: what each records, the subcontractor's accounts, retention and advances, and how both are attached to a project. - entities: Contractor, ContractingAdvisory, ContractorClassification - screens (ar): مقاول باطن, إستشاري, فئة مقاول باطن
- [Modify Contractor Info Request](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-modify-contractor-info-request.html) (ar: طلب تعديل بيانات المقاول (Modify Contractor Info Request)): The Modify Contractor Info Request document for updating an existing contractor or adding a new one: its fields, the two apply buttons, what is copied, the draft option on the term and its messages. - entities: ModifyContractorInfoReq - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Modify Contractor Info Request
- [Units, Tasks and Other Lookups](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-lookups.html) (ar: وحدات القياس والمهام والملفات المساعدة): Reference for the small Contracting lookup files: Contracting Units of Measure, Contracting Tasks, Term Categories 1 and 2, Fine Reasons, Direct-Cost Items and Tax Extract Terms. - entities: ContractingUOM, ContractingTask, ContrTermCategory, ContrTermCategory2, ContractingFineReason, ContractingDirectCost, ContractingTaxExtractTerm - screens (ar): وحدة قياس مقاولات, مهمة مقاولات, تصنيف بند مقاولة, تصنيف بند مقاولة 2, سبب غرامة مقاولات, بند تكلفة مقاولات, بند مستخلص ضريبي

#### Contracting Document Terms

- [Contracting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات مستندات المقاولات)

- [Material and Payment Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-materials.html) (ar: توجيه مستندات الخامات والدفعات): Document term settings for Contracting material and payment documents: which term serves which document, material issued to your own project versus to a subcontractor, advance and other payments, and fines, with one month on Tower A as the example. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

- [Project Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-contract.html) (ar: عقد المشروع): The Project Contract master file: how terms arrive on it, the terms, conditions, tasks and payments grids, contract versus addendum or modification, what blocks a save, why it freezes once extracts exist, and carving out a subcontract. - entities: ProjectContract - screens (ar): عقد مشروع - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract
- [Project Contract Updates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-contract-updates.html) (ar: تعديل عقد المشروع): The Project Contract Update (variation order) that changes a project contract after its first extract: filling it in, actions, refreshing the snapshot and what blocks commit or delete. - entities: ProjectContractUpdate - screens (ar): تعديل عقد مشروع - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Update
- [Project Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-execution.html) (ar: حصر كميات المشروع): The Project Contract Execution document, a quantity-only statement of work done per period with no prices and no accounting effect: the screen, the Executions grid, back-dating, save checks and how extracts use it. - entities: ProjContractExecution - screens (ar): حصر كميات مشروع - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Execution
- [Project Extracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-extracts.html) (ar: مستخلص المشروع): The Project Contract Extract, the owner-side billing document: extract types, the Details grid, the seven grids, conditions such as retention, advances and fines, the net payable and the journal it produces. - entities: ProjContrExtract - screens (ar): مستخلص مشروع - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Extract
- [Taxes on Extracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-extract-taxes.html) (ar: الضرائب على المستخلصات): How project extract lines are mapped to tax extract terms for tax reporting and e-invoicing: the tax extract term master file, the Missing Tax Term Strategy switch, the Taxing Details grid and tax percentages. - entities: ProjContrExtract, ContractingTaxExtractTerm - screens (ar): مستخلص مشروع, بند مستخلص ضريبي
- [Project Advance Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-advances.html) (ar: الدفعات المقدمة من العميل): The Project Advance Payment document: recording the owner's advance on a contract, the recovery rule, how each extract recovers it, what the advance books and what blocks a commit. - entities: ProjectAdvancePayment - screens (ar): دفعة مشروع مقدمة - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Advance Payment
- [Project Fines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-fines.html) (ar: غرامات عقد المشروع): The Project Contract Fine document: recording penalties against the owner contract, its own journal entry, its cost against the BOQ term, deduction from the next extract, and the rules that lock or block it. - entities: ProjectContractFine - screens (ar): سند غرامة عقد مشروع - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Fine
- [Measurements, Submittals and Handover](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-measurements-and-approvals.html) (ar: طلبات الرفع والاعتمادات والتسليم): Records around the contracting billing chain: Application Form (the customer's fit-out request), Measurements Request (site visit before pricing), Customer Submittal (material approval) and Project Deliver Letter (handover); none of them books anything. - entities: MeasurementsRequest, ApplicationForm, AppFormElement, CustomerSubmittal, ProjectDeliverLetter - screens (ar): طلب رفع مقاسات, نموذج طلب, بند نموذج طلب, اعتماد العميل للصنف, خطاب تسليم مشروع

- [Document Terms for Project Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/invoicing/ecpa-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات المشاريع): The document terms for Project Management (ECPA) documents: the seven documents and five term screens, account sides, what the invoice, expense and Tasks Executing terms book, the TimeSheet Approval term's one setting, and the options that change behaviour. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Service Center

- [Service Center](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/) (ar: مركز الخدمة): Landing page for the Service Center module: the workshop, the car showroom, insurance and instalment paperwork, the rental register and reception queues, and where to start reading for each.
- [Service Center Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/servicecenter-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على مركز الخدمة): Overview of the Service Center module: its two menu roots, the separate workshop and showroom vehicle registers, the six licence codes and what each enables, and the rental, delivery and queue extras. - licence: srvcenter, srvcenter-subitems, srvcenter-insurance-and-installments, srvcenter-rental-assets, srvcenter-mobile-delivery, srvcenter-service-queues
- [Setting Up a Service Center](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/servicecenter-getting-started.html) (ar: إعداد مركز الخدمة): Step-by-step setup of Service Center in a new database: saving the settings screen, decisions to make first, workshop setup, turning car tracking on for the dealership, and the extras. - licence: srvcenter, srvcenter-subitems, srvcenter-insurance-and-installments, srvcenter-rental-assets, srvcenter-mobile-delivery, srvcenter-service-queues
- [Service Center Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/servicecenter-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات مركز الخدمة): The Service Center settings screen: capacity shares, pricing, job orders and invoicing, the execution screen, vehicle history and car options. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Administration → Settings → System Settings - licence: srvcenter-rental-assets
- [Reports and Print Forms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/servicecenter-reports-and-forms.html) (ar: التقارير ونماذج الطباعة): The only shipped Service Center report and print form, the rental-asset schedule and the reception inspection slip, plus what is missing (no job order form, no dashboards) and where to find the figures instead. - licence: srvcenter-rental-assets, srvcenter

#### Workshop Setup

- [Workshop Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/) (ar: إعداد الورشة)
- [Work Centers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-work-centers.html) (ar: مراكز الخدمة (صالات الإنتاج)): The Service Center Work Center file: its spare-parts store, hour price, bays-times-hours capacity and dimensions, the Job Orders tab, why the hour price is only a fallback, and how to set one up. - entities: SrvCWorkCenter - screens (ar): مركز خدمة - menu: Service Center → Master Files → Service Center Work Center - licence: srvcenter
- [Service Tasks](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-tasks.html) (ar: مهام الخدمة): The Service Center Task master file: standard hours, hour price, materials and recurrence of a repair step, and where a job order takes its hours and labour rate from. - entities: SrvCTask - screens (ar): المهمه - menu: Service Center → Master Files → Service Center Task - licence: srvcenter
- [Services and Operation Groups](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-operations.html) (ar: الخدمات ومجموعات العمليات): The Service Center Operation (service) master file that bundles tasks into one package, priced per line or as a total, and how a service reaches a job order. - entities: SrvCOperation - screens (ar): خدمة - menu: Service Center → Master Files → Service Center Operation - licence: srvcenter
- [The Serviced Product](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-product-file.html) (ar: ملف المنتج (المركبة)): The Service Center Product, used as the vehicle file: chassis, plate, owner and insurer, how the odometer fields behave, the read-only status, what documents write back to it, and how to create one. - entities: SrvCProduct - menu: Service Center → Master Files → Product - licence: srvcenter
- [Brands, Models and Model Categories](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-brands-and-models.html) (ar: الماركات والموديلات وتصنيفاتها): The Brand, Model and Product Model Category master files that classify serviced vehicles, what the model drives in the workshop, and how to set them up. - entities: SrvProductModel, SrvcBrand, SrvProductModelCategory - screens (ar): ماركة منتج, تصنيف موديل - licence: srvcenter
- [Tags and Classification Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/workshop-setup/servicecenter-classification-files.html) (ar: ملفات التصنيف والوسوم): The three Service Center classification files, Accessories Kit, Visit Type and Standard Operation Classification: what each one classifies, how the visit type affects the booking capacity check, and why to fill them in. - entities: AccessoriesKit, SrvCVisitType, SrvCOperationClassification - screens (ar): مجموعة ملحقات, نوع الزيارة, تصنيف خدمة - licence: srvcenter

#### Job Order Cycle

- [Job Order Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/) (ar: دورة أمر الشغل)
- [Job Order Cycle Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-job-cycle-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على دورة أمر الشغل): Overview of the Service Center job order cycle from service request and job estimation through job order, closing, customer, insurance and warranty invoices and gate pass, and which documents need a term. - licence: srvcenter
- [Service Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-service-request.html) (ar: طلبات الخدمة): The Service Request appointment document: booking a visit and its services, the main and details pages, how the daily capacity check works, what committing it does, and moving from booking to job estimation. - entities: SrvCServiceRequest - screens (ar): طلب خدمة - menu: Service Center → Documents → Service Request - licence: srvcenter
- [Job Estimations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-job-estimation.html) (ar: المقايسات): The Job Estimation quote: pricing the work and splitting it between payers before the job starts, what the estimation does not check, committing it, revising it with an Estimation Update, and the next step. - entities: SrvCJobEstimation, SrvCJobEstimationUpdate - screens (ar): مقايسة, تعديل مقايسة - menu: Service Center → Documents → Job Estimation - licence: srvcenter
- [The Job Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-job-order.html) (ar: أمر الشغل): The Service Center Job Order screen: the operations grid and labour pricing, payer percentages, resources and spare parts, statuses and what they block, its validations, adding tasks mid-job, and what committing it does. - entities: SrvCJobOrder, SrvcAddTaskToJobOrder - screens (ar): أمر شغل, إضافة مهام الي أمر الشغل - menu: Service Center → Documents → Service Center Job Order - licence: srvcenter
- [Who Pays for What](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-payer-split.html) (ar: توزيع القيمة على الجهات الدافعة): How each job order operation and spare-part line is split between customer, insurance, warranty and internal shares, the rules checked on commit, and where each share is invoiced. - entities: SrvCJobOrder - screens (ar): أمر شغل
- [Closing a Job Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-job-order-closing.html) (ar: إغلاق أمر الشغل): The Job Order Closing document: what it totals per payer, the journal entry and stock issue it creates, the next-visit date, what it refuses, its messages and how to undo a closing. - entities: SrvCJobOrderClosing - screens (ar): إغلاق أمر شغل - menu: Service Center → Documents → Job Order Closing - licence: srvcenter
- [Invoicing a Job Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-job-order-invoicing.html) (ar: فوترة أمر الشغل): How a job order is invoiced: the three buttons that create separate customer, insurer and warranty invoices, how their lines are built, sales orders as an alternative, editing a generated invoice, and the gate pass. - entities: SrvCJobOrder - screens (ar): أمر شغل - licence: srvcenter
- [Gate Pass](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-gate-pass.html) (ar: تصريح عبور البوابة): The Service Center Gate Pass: the seven checks that a job order is invoiced and paid for every payer before the car is released, what it does when committed, how to configure it, and the messages it shows. - entities: SrvCGatePass - menu: Service Center → Documents → Service Center Gate Pass - licence: srvcenter
- [Odometer Readings and Service Intervals](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/servicecenter/job-cycle/servicecenter-odometer-and-service-intervals.html) (ar: قراءات العداد وفترات الصيانة): How Service Center tracks vehicle mileage: the odometer figures on the vehicle file, the Kilo Metrage document and its due-task columns, the last-service register, seeding history with the Product Task Opening Document, and what mileage does not drive. - entities: SrvCKiloMetrage, SrvCProductTaskOpeningDoc - screens (ar): سجل قراءة العداد, افتتاحي مهمات منتج - menu: Service Center → Documents → Kilo Metrage - licence: srvcenter
