- [Recording Marks](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/education-marks.html) (ar: رصد الدرجات): The Education Marks Balance screen: recording one student's marks per subject on one course and semester, and where its subject lines come from. - entities: EDMarksBalance - screens (ar): رصيد درجات - menu: Education → Master Files → Marks Balance
- [Buses, Meals and School Trips](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/education/education-transport-and-meals.html) (ar: الحافلات والوجبات والرحلات المدرسية): The Education registers for school buses, meals and trips: Bus, Bus Action, Pickup Plan, Bus Info Updater, Meal Type, meal entitlements and delivery plans, and School Trip, all of which record information without creating accounting entries. - entities: EDBus, EDBusAction, EDBusPickupPlan, EDBusInfoUpdater, EDMealType, EDMealsDetails, EDMealDeliveryPlan, EDSchoolTrip - screens (ar): وسيلة نقل, إجراء سيارة مدرسية, خط سير سيارة مدرسية, تحديث بيانات سيارة مدرسية, نوع وجبة مدرسية, تفاصيل الوجبات المدرسية, خطة توصيل الوجبات المدرسية, رحلة مدرسية

- [Administering Nama Mobile from the ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/mobile-administration.html) (ar: إدارة تطبيق نما موبايل من النظام): Administering Nama Mobile from the ERP: a map of every screen under Basic → Mobile Apps, when a change reaches the phone, the API Credentials record each app user gets, and the Mobile Application Dashboard. - entities: MobileAppDashboard - screens (ar): لوحة تطبيق الموبايل - menu: Basic → Mobile Apps → Mobile Application Dashboard

- [Mobile QR Integrator Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/mobile/mobile-qr-integrator.html) (ar: دليل Mobile QR Integrator): The Mobile QR Integrator is a powerful feature that enables Nama ERP to respond to QR codes scanned by mobile devices. - entities: MobileQRIntegrator - menu: Basic → Mobile Apps → Mobile QR Integrator

### e-commerce Integration

- [e-commerce Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/) (ar: تكامل التجارة الإلكترونية): Guides for connecting Nama ERP to online storefronts and fulfilment platforms: the shared e-commerce integration settings, then Salla, Zid, Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Atheer, Salasa, OTO, Amazon and Omniful, and what moves in each direction.
- [E-Commerce Integration Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/ecommerce-integration-guide.html) (ar: دليل تكامل التجارة الإلكترونية): This guide explains the settings that every online shop connected to Nama ERP shares: the shop record, linking items to the shop's products, turning shop orders into sales documents, and sending stock, prices and items back to the shop... - entities: MAGMagentoSite, MagentoItemLinker, MagentoPriceUpdaterDoc, EcommerceProductConfig, EcommerceCategoryConfig - screens (ar): ملف ربط الأصناف بموقع ماجنتو, مستند تحديث أسعار ماجنتو, إعدادات منتج بالمتجر الالكتروني - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Salla Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/salla-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع سلة (Salla)): This page explains how Nama ERP works with a Salla store: connecting the store, bringing Salla orders and returns into Nama, sending prices and stock quantities to Salla, and receiving new orders within a minute through webhooks. - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Zid Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/zid-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع زد (Zid)): This page explains how to connect a Zid (zid.sa) store to Nama ERP: the two ways to authorise the connection, how Zid orders are read into Nama, what Nama sends back to Zid (prices and quantities), and how abandoned carts are collected. - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Shopify Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/shopify-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع شوبيفاي (Shopify)): This page explains how to connect a Shopify store to Nama ERP: how the connection is set up, how Shopify orders become sales documents in Nama, and how products, prices and stock quantities are sent from Nama to Shopify. - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [WooCommerce Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/woocommerce-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع ووكومرس (WooCommerce)): This page explains how to connect a WooCommerce shop to Nama ERP: importing shop orders as sales documents, sending products, prices and stock to the shop, writing order statuses and notes back... - entities: MAGMagentoSite, RewardPointsConfig - screens (ar): إعدادات نقاط المكافأة - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [BigCommerce Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/bigcommerce-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع BigCommerce): This page explains how to connect a BigCommerce store to Nama ERP: the connection settings, how BigCommerce orders are read into Nama, and how products, prices and stock quantities are sent to the store. - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Salasa Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/salasa-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع سلاسه (Salasa)): This page explains how to connect Nama ERP to Salasa, the fulfilment (3PL) company that stores your goods in its warehouses and ships your orders: the two records to set up, how Salasa's webhooks reach Nama... - entities: EcommerceShippingSite, MAGMagentoSite - screens (ar): موقع شحن الكتروني - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Ecommerce Shipping Site
- [OTO Stock Synchronisation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/oto-stock-sync.html) (ar: مزامنة المخزون مع OTO): This page explains how Nama ERP keeps the stock quantities in OTO's fulfilment locations in step with the quantities in your Nama warehouses. - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Atheer Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/atheer-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع أثير (Atheer)): This page explains how the Atheer platform sends its orders and requests into Nama ERP: the Magento Site record to set up, the address Atheer calls, the four operations it can send, the ZATCA QR code Nama returns... - entities: MAGMagentoSite - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Magento Site
- [Omniful Integration Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/omniful-integration.html) (ar: دليل التكامل مع Omniful): Nama ERP integrates with Omniful, a unified supply chain platform that provides comprehensive warehouse management and order fulfillment capabilities. - entities: OmnifulConfig - menu: e-Commerce Integration → Master Files → Omniful Configuration
- [Amazon Order Notifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecommerce/amazon-order-notifications.html) (ar: إشعارات طلبات أمازون): Setting up Amazon order-change notifications so shipped Amazon orders become Sales Orders in Nama automatically: the AWS SQS queue and IAM user, the Amazon site settings in Nama, the scheduled polling task, and how to check it works. - entities: MAGMagentoSite

- [What Nama Sends to Eltezam](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/eltezam/eltezam-data-sources.html) (ar: ما الذي يرسله «نما» إلى التزام): Where each value Nama sends to Eltezam comes from, operation by operation (employee, job, payslip, qualification, vacation and appraisal info), and which documents count as in the period. - entities: EltezamSubmissionDoc, EltezamConfiguration - screens (ar): إرسال بيانات التزام, إعدادات خدمة التزام
- [Eltezam Submissions and Sending](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/integrations/eltezam/eltezam-submissions-and-sending.html) (ar: مستندات إرسال التزام وطريقة الإرسال): Every time the agency reports to MCS — the monthly payslips, a batch of new hires, the year's appraisals — it does so through an MCS Eltezam Submission (إرسال بيانات التزام), under Documents → MCS Eltezam Submission in the integrations menu. - entities: EltezamSubmissionDoc - screens (ar): إرسال بيانات التزام - menu: Integrations → Documents → MCS Eltezam Submission

### Artificial Intelligence

- [Artificial Intelligence](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/) (ar: الذكاء الاصطناعي): The AI module brings language-model capabilities inside Nama ERP — but in a governed way: the AI can do nothing except through tools the system administrator defines, and every tool executes as a real user with the full security model applied.
- [Getting Better Support with an AI Assistant](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/ai-assisted-support.html) (ar: دعم أفضل بمساعد ذكاء اصطناعي): Setting up an AI assistant for Nama support step by step: installing Claude Desktop and Git, downloading the documentation knowledge base, asking questions, keeping it current, connecting it to a live system through the MCP server, and choosing which tools to give it. - entities: AIToolDefinition
- [AI Tool Definitions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/ai-tool-definitions.html) (ar: تعريفات أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي (AI Tool Definitions)): The AI Tool Definition screen where administrators define the tools an AI assistant may call: basic data, access control, and the query, report, entity flow and system tool types. - entities: AIToolDefinition - menu: Artificial Intelligence → Master Files → AI Tool Definition
- [The In-System AI Assistant](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/ai-assistant.html) (ar: المساعد الذكي داخل النظام): Besides connecting external clients through the MCP server, Nama ERP ships with a built-in AI assistant that works right inside the interface: a chat window the user opens to ask questions in natural language — Arabic or English...
- [AI Module Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/ai-configuration.html) (ar: إعداد وحدة الذكاء الاصطناعي): Before the AI assistant answers a question, or an MCP client connects to the system, the module needs basic setup: which language model do you use? - entities: ConfigEntry, AIRecordEmbeddingConfig - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام
- [Nama ERP MCP Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ai/ai-mcp-server.html) (ar: خادم MCP لنظام نما ERP): MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the open standard AI assistants — such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and others — use to connect to external systems, read their data, and act on them. - entities: AIToolDefinition, APICredentials

## External Integrations

- [External Integrations](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/) (ar: التكاملات الخارجية): Landing page for connecting Nama ERP to other systems: the REST API, integration scenarios, sending documents by link, attendance machines and external databases.
- [Nama ERP REST API](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/nama-erp-api.html) (ar: واجهة برمجية REST لنظام نما ERP): Nama ERP has a REST API for creating, reading, updating and deleting records of any entity, and publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 description of each entity for third-party systems to build against. - entities: APICredentials
- [Integration Scenarios Between Nama and Other Systems](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/system-integration-scenarios.html) (ar: سيناريوهات الربط بين نظام نما والأنظمة الأخرى): A framework for answering whether Nama can integrate with another system, by direction of data flow (reading from or writing to Nama, or Nama calling the other system), with questions to ask and who bears the cost.
- [Integration with Attendance Machines](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/attendance-machines-integration.html) (ar: الربط مع ماكينات الحضور والانصراف): The two ways to bring attendance machine data into Nama, the attcron application or a direct SQL Server link with a scheduled import, plus re-importing and recalculating attendance on a Time Attendance document and sending the results to employees. - entities: AttendanceMachineConfig, TimeAttendance - screens (ar): إعدادات ماكينة الحضور, حضور / إنصراف
- [The attcron Attendance Agent](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/attcron-agent.html) (ar: تطبيق attcron لسحب بيانات الحضور (The attcron Attendance Agent)): Installing and running attcron, the branch-side agent that collects attendance machine punches and pushes them to Nama: prerequisites, first connection, the daily screen, upgrades and troubleshooting. - entities: AttendanceMachineConfig - screens (ar): إعدادات ماكينة الحضور
- [Reporting Medicine Movements to the SFDA](https://docs.namasoft.com/integration/sfda-drug-track-and-trace.html) (ar: الإبلاغ عن حركات الأدوية للهيئة السعودية للغذاء والدواء): How Nama reports medicine movements to the Saudi SFDA track-and-trace (RSD) system from warehouse documents: the SFDA RSD Configuration, movement mapping, statuses, line results, failed reports and incoming dispatches. - entities: SFDARSDConfig - screens (ar): إعدادات تتبع الأدوية (الهيئة السعودية للغذاء والدواء) - menu: Inventory → Settings → SFDA RSD Configuration

- [Shortcuts Definition and User Favourites](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/shortcuts-and-user-favourites.html) (ar: تعريف الاختصارات ومفضلة المستخدم): Two screens under Administration → Display Customization shape what a user's fingers and eyes reach first, and neither of them changes a single record. - entities: ShortCutsDefinition, UserFavourites - screens (ar): تعريف اختصارات, مفضلة مستخدم
- [OAuth Files (Google Sign-In for Gmail and Google Drive)](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/oauth-files.html) (ar: ملفات OAuth (تسجيل الدخول بحساب Google لـ Gmail وGoogle Drive)): The OAuth File screen that holds Google sign-in access for Gmail sending and Google Drive backup checks: its fields, authorising a file step by step, lost access and using your own Google application. - entities: OAuthFile - menu: Administration → Other → OAuth File
- [Hijri Table (the Hijri Calendar Nama Uses)](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/hijri-table.html) (ar: الجدول الهجري (Hijri Table) — التقويم الهجري الذي يعتمده نما): The Hijri Table screen that Nama uses to convert dates to the Hijri calendar: what depends on it, how to enter the start date and month lengths, an example, extending the calendar later, and the messages you may see. - entities: HijriTable - screens (ar): جدول هجري - menu: Basic → Settings → Hijri Table
- [Wizard File (the Setup Wizard's Record)](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/wizard-file.html) (ar: ملف المعالج (Wizard File) — سجل معالج الإعداد): A new installation is usually set up through the setup wizard: a step-by-step questionnaire that asks how the company works — its currency, branches, which documents it uses, whether fixed assets are created from purchases, and so on... - entities: WizardFile - menu: Basic → Documents → Wizard File
- [Guidelines for Submitting Development Requests by Support and Setup Teams](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/dev-request-guidelines.html) (ar: ضوابط إنشاء طلبات تطوير من قبل أقسام الدعم الفني والتجهيز بالشركة): What support and setup teams must include in a development request for a bug or a new feature (logs, table name, backup URL, reproduction steps) and how to tell when the fix is released.

### Troubleshooting

- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/troubleshooting/) (ar: استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها): Troubleshooting landing page that maps common support complaints (slowness, freezes, missing ledger entries, background work, licence and access, wrong figures, e-invoicing) to the page that explains each.
- [Critical Errors at Login](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/troubleshooting/critical-errors.html) (ar: الأخطاء الحرجة عند الدخول): The critical errors list shown at login: how it is built and refreshed, who sees it, how to post your own message to users, and every health check with its cause and fix.
- [When the System Is Slow](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/troubleshooting/system-is-slow.html) (ar: حين يصبح النظام بطيئًا): Diagnosing a slow system step by step: narrowing down the complaint, seeing what the server is doing now, reports and background work that hold users up, slow searches, database health, and what to send to Namasoft.
- [Troubleshooting System Hanging or Unresponsiveness](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/troubleshooting/troubleshooting-system-hanging.html) (ar: استكشاف أخطاء توقف النظام أو عدم استجابته (Troubleshooting System Hanging or Unresponsiveness)): When your Nama ERP system becomes unresponsive, slow, or appears to hang, the most effective diagnostic tool is a thread dump (also called a stack dump).
- [General FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/troubleshooting/general-faq.html) (ar: أسئلة عامة): Answers to recurring support questions that do not belong to one screen: a blank error when searching with the lens, granting permissions on all record types at once, installing SQL Server on new SSDs, adding the discussion panel to a screen...

### Reprocessing Transactions

- [Reprocessing Transactions](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/) (ar: إعادة معالجة الحركات): This folder holds the recovery tools: the scripts and utilities that rebuild quantities, costs, ledger balances and debt ages for a database whose numbers are already wrong.
- [Reprocessing Quantity, Cost, and Stock Ages](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/reprocess-qty-and-cost.html) (ar: إعادة معالجة الكميات والتكاليف وأعمار المخزون (Reprocessing Quantity, Cost, and Stock Ages)): Scripts and utility links that rebuild quantity transactions, average cost and stock ages from the documents, either for the whole database with Tomcat stopped or partially, starting from a date.
- [Accounting Utilities - Ledger and Debt Ages Reprocessing](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/reprocess-ledger-and-debt-ages.html) (ar: أدوات المحاسبة - إعادة معالجة دفتر الأستاذ وأعمار الديون (Accounting Utilities - Ledger and Debt Ages Reprocessing)): SQL that rebuilds ledger transactions and debt ages from the committed documents, plus queries that find and fix zombie or unbalanced ledger transactions, missing dimension balances, financial paper entries and account deletion problems.
- [Queries to Check for (and Fix) Cost And Qty Problems](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/cost-and-qty-problems.html) (ar: استعلامات للكشف عن مشاكل التكلفة والكميات (وإصلاحها)): SQL queries that check whether inventory cost agrees with the ledger, and repair the usual causes when it does not: stale accounting configuration on inventory requests, zombie inventory requests, quantities that reached zero but still carry cost...
- [Inventory Related Utility Queries](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/inventory-utilities.html) (ar: استعلامات الأدوات المساعدة للمخزون): SQL queries for diagnosing and repairing inventory data: reopening a stock taking, allowing overdraft for all items and closing it again, changed base units, the dates an overdraft happened, item dimension quantities, expiry dates and lots...
- [Manufacturing Utilities](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/manufacturing-utilities.html) (ar: أدوات التصنيع (Manufacturing Utilities)): Two SQL repairs for manufacturing: a production delivery whose cost does not match the cost of the materials issued for it (the cost callback problem), and leftover production movement system entries.
- [Fixed Assets Module Utilities](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/fixed-asset-utilities.html) (ar: أدوات وحدة الأصول الثابتة (Fixed Assets Module Utilities)): Two SQL repairs for the fixed assets module: resetting an asset's last depreciation date after its depreciation was deleted, and fixing addition/deduction entries that always show zero.
- [Real Estate Utilities](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/real-estate-utilities.html) (ar: أدوات العقارات (Real Estate Utilities)): One SQL repair for real estate contracts: recalculating the system paid, collect requested and collected by financial papers values when installment payment entries have lost their reference.
- [Batch Utilities That Work From a List File](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/batch-utilities-from-file.html) (ar: أدوات تعمل على دفعة سجلات من ملف): Utilities that act on a list of records read from a text file on the server: recommit, re-replicate, delete, regenerate ledger or inventory effects, export to another server, and compare two files.
- [Rebuilding Module System Entries](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/module-entries-rebuild-utilities.html) (ar: إعادة بناء قيود النظام في الوحدات): Several modules keep a running history beside their documents: who owns each property unit, whether a unit is rented or free, which state each employee is in, how much vacation balance each employee has, which status each customer car has reached...
- [Approval Repair Utilities](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/approval-repair-utilities.html) (ar: أدوات إصلاح الموافقات): Two admin utilities that repair stale approval cases: Regenerate Approvals Summary rewrites the summaries of in-progress cases, and Remove Zombie Approvals clears pending approvals left behind by deleted or already committed records.
- [Database Related Operations](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/db-operations.html) (ar: عمليات قاعدة البيانات (Database Related Operations)): SQL Server operations an administrator runs directly against a Nama database: snapshot isolation, finding running queries and table sizes, repairing a suspect database, dropping the foreign keys that stop users, attachments...
- [Suggest Indexes for Large Detail Tables](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/suggest-index-creation.html) (ar: اقتراح إنشاء Indexes لجداول التفاصيل الكبيرة): This article provides guidance on identifying large detail tables in your database that are missing essential indexes on their foreign key columns, which may lead to performance issues when selecting records.
- [General Purpose Utility Queries](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/general-purpose-utility-queries.html) (ar: استعلامات عامة متعددة الأغراض (General Purpose Utility Queries)): General SQL helpers that are not tied to one module: generating date ranges, finding missing document numbers, unlinking documents from their source documents, cancelling a document's current approval case...
- [Replication Utilities](https://docs.namasoft.com/admin/reprocessing/replication.html) (ar: أدوات النسخ المتطابق (Replication Utilities)): SQL that clears sent messages, and messages for inactive sites, out of the replication message tables, and the steps for taking a backup of the head office and restoring it at a branch.

## Entity Flows Reference

- [Entity Flows Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/)

### Core

- [Core](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/)
- [Field Maps in Nama ERP - Complete Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/ai-generated-field-maps-documentation.html): Field maps are a powerful feature in Nama ERP that allow automatic copying and transformation of data between different entities (records).
- [DeleteRelatedEntityAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/DeleteRelatedEntityAction.html): Deletes related entities that were previously generated by EAGenerateEntityFromEntityAction. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAllowUseAsFromDocOfAField](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAllowUseAsFromDocOfAField.html): Allows a specific field to be used as a source document reference ("from doc") in document creation workflows. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAltCodeValidator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAltCodeValidator.html): Validates the alternative code (altCode) field of entities to ensure they follow specific formatting requirements. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAttachReportResultToRecord](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAttachReportResultToRecord.html): Generates reports automatically and attaches the resulting files as attachments to the current entity record. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutoCollectSignAndSentEInvoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoCollectSignAndSentEInvoice.html): Automates the complete e-Invoice submission process (Egyptian Tax Authority or Saudi ZATCA) by collecting eligible invoices, creating submission documents, digitally signing them, and sending them to the tax authority. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutoEscalateApprovalToFallBackEmployee](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoEscalateApprovalToFallBackEmployee.html): Automatically escalates overdue approval cases to the fallback employee defined in the approval definition. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutoEscalateApprovalToSupervisor](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoEscalateApprovalToSupervisor.html): Automatically escalates overdue approval cases to the supervisor of the assigned employee when timeout periods are exceeded. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutoSendEInvoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutoSendEInvoice.html): Automatically submits individual invoices to tax authorities (ZATCA/Egyptian Tax Authority) immediately after invoice creation or modification. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityAction.html): Automatically generates related entities from source entities and handles their deletion when the source entity is deleted. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityActionWithApproval](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAAutomaticGenerateEntityFromEntityActionWithApproval.html): Automatically generates related entities from source entities while respecting approval workflows. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACacheEvicter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACacheEvicter.html): Clears Hibernate second-level cache for a specific entity type, ensuring cached data is refreshed and subsequent queries retrieve current information from the database. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACalcCurrencyRate](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACalcCurrencyRate.html): Automatically calculates and sets exchange rates for foreign currency transactions on document entities. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACalcCurrencyRateInDetails](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACalcCurrencyRateInDetails.html): Calculates and sets exchange rates for foreign currencies in document detail lines (collections). - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACheckAndUpdateLinkAtOnlinePaymentTransactionSysEntry](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACheckAndUpdateLinkAtOnlinePaymentTransactionSysEntry.html): Performs maintenance on online payment transaction entries by checking for expired payment links and updating their status. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACheckDailyBackupOnGoogleDrive](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACheckDailyBackupOnGoogleDrive.html): Monitors Google Drive folders for backup files, verifying daily backups were created successfully. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACheckTaxAuthorityRejectedByReceiverDocuments](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACheckTaxAuthorityRejectedByReceiverDocuments.html): Automatically checks tax authority status for documents within their 3-day review window (from document date) and updates their status in the system. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAClearGoogleDriveTrash](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAClearGoogleDriveTrash.html): Empties the Google Drive trash folder, permanently deleting all trashed files. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACloseFiscalPeriodsInRange](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACloseFiscalPeriodsInRange.html): Automatically closes fiscal periods that have passed their end dates. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACodeValidator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACodeValidator.html): Validates entity code fields against formatting rules including length limits, prefixes/suffixes, and regex patterns. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EACopyEmptyAccountsFromBag](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EACopyEmptyAccountsFromBag.html): Copies subsidiary account assignments from account bag to fill empty subsidiary account fields. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADeleteFromAnotherServer](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADeleteFromAnotherServer.html): Deletes entities from remote Nama ERP servers through web services to maintain data synchronization across multi-server environments. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADeleteFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADeleteFromQuery.html): Executes SQL query to find entities, then deletes all returned entities. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADeleteNotificationsByDuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADeleteNotificationsByDuration.html): Deletes user notifications older than a given number of days. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADeleteOldFiles](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADeleteOldFiles.html): Manages file system cleanup by keeping only a specified number of recent files in folders, deleting older files to maintain storage efficiency. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADetailsRemover](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADetailsRemover.html): Removes specific lines from document detail collections based on query conditions or predefined criteria for selective cleanup of detail records. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EADownloadURLsIntoAttachments](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EADownloadURLsIntoAttachments.html): Downloads the file at each URL field value into the matching attachment field, setting the file name on the stored file. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAEmptifyTomcatTemp](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAEmptifyTomcatTemp.html): Cleans Tomcat temp directory by removing old files and folders while preserving recent items to manage server storage and improve performance. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAErrorIfQueryNotMatched](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAErrorIfQueryNotMatched.html): Validates entity data using SQL query and displays custom error message if validation fails. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAExecuteUpdateQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAExecuteUpdateQuery.html): Executes custom SQL UPDATE, INSERT, or DELETE statements directly against the database for bulk operations and data modifications with optional cache eviction. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAExecuteUpdateQueryOnDifferentDatasource](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAExecuteUpdateQueryOnDifferentDatasource.html): Executes SQL UPDATE, INSERT, or DELETE statements on external databases using configured data sources for cross-database operations and system integration. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAExportAttachments](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAExportAttachments.html): Exports file attachments from entity attachment fields to server file system with flexible naming and organization options. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAFieldsValuesCalculator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAFieldsValuesCalculator.html): Performs bulk field assignments and calculations on entities using flexible mapping syntax. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAForceApplyInstallmentEffects](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAForceApplyInstallmentEffects.html): Recalculates and updates installment payment tracking for documents with installment-based payments, synchronizing paid amounts and remaining balances. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAForceUsersToChangePassword](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAForceUsersToChangePassword.html): Flags users to be required to change their password on their next login when their last password change is older than a configurable number of days (default: 45). - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateDraftEntityFromEntityAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateDraftEntityFromEntityAction.html): Creates new entities from existing entities and saves them as draft documents for review. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateDraftEntityFromEntityActionNoFlush](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateDraftEntityFromEntityActionNoFlush.html): Same as EAGenerateDraftEntityFromEntityAction but without automatic database flush for batch processing optimization. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateEntityFromEntityAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateEntityFromEntityAction.html): Creates new entities from existing entities with full database commitment. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionNoFlush](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionNoFlush.html): Creates new entities from existing entities with full commitment but without immediate database flush. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionNoFlushWithApproval](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionNoFlushWithApproval.html): Combines entity generation with approval workflow integration but without immediate database flush for batch processing optimization. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionWithApproval](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateEntityFromEntityActionWithApproval.html): Creates new entities from existing entities with full commitment and approval process integration. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateKNetPaymentURLs](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateKNetPaymentURLs.html): Generates KNet payment URLs for documents supporting online payment processing, creating both direct and redirect URLs for Kuwait's KNet payment gateway integration. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGenerateMyFatoorahPaymentURLs](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGenerateMyFatoorahPaymentURLs.html): Generates MyFatoorah payment URLs for documents supporting online payment processing, creating payment links through MyFatoorah's gateway for Middle East region payment methods. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGroovyAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGroovyAction.html): Runs a custom Groovy script as an entity flow action. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAGuessEntityFromNames](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAGuessEntityFromNames.html): Intelligently guesses and assigns entity references based on name similarity matching using advanced string distance algorithms for data import, migration, and automated entity linking. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAIgnoringNotFoundTargetFieldsValuesCalculator](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAIgnoringNotFoundTargetFieldsValuesCalculator.html): Performs field value calculations with error tolerance, extending the standard field calculator but ignoring errors to ensure processing continues despite individual field assignment failures. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAJsonRecordExporter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAJsonRecordExporter.html): Exports entity data as JSON to external systems via HTTP requests with field filtering, renaming, and dynamic URL generation. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EALoyalityEarnReward](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EALoyalityEarnReward.html): Processes customer loyalty reward points earning for invoice transactions, calculating and awarding points based on purchase amounts while handling returns and external system integration. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysAfter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysAfter.html): Adjusts entity creation dates to ensure they always occur after a specified hour by adding random milliseconds while keeping the date within the same day. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysBefore](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysBefore.html): Adjusts document creation dates to ensure they always occur before a specified hour by synchronizing with value date and subtracting random milliseconds. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysBetween](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAMakeCreationDateAlwaysBetween.html): Adjusts document creation dates to ensure they fall within a specified time window by synchronizing with value date and adding/subtracting random milliseconds until time is between start and end hours. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAMakeCreationDateInValueDate](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAMakeCreationDateInValueDate.html): Synchronizes document creation dates with their value dates while preserving the original creation time, ensuring date consistency without losing timing information. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EANamaCloudBackupPrepare](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EANamaCloudBackupPrepare.html): Prepares Google Drive backup configuration by scanning folder structures, authenticating via OAuth, and generating configuration for backup validation processes. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAOpenFiscalPeriodsInRange](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAOpenFiscalPeriodsInRange.html): Opens fiscal periods that overlap with a specified target date. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPostGoPayOfflinePayment](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPostGoPayOfflinePayment.html): Processes offline payments for GoPay digital wallet transactions, either recording the payment directly or crediting customer balance based on configuration for receipt vouchers linked to GoPay-enabled invoices. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPreventChangingFields](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPreventChangingFields.html): Enforces field-level data integrity by preventing unauthorized changes to specified header and detail fields, with optional line addition/deletion protection and conditional SQL logic support. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPreventFromDocOfUsageAgain](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPreventFromDocOfUsageAgain.html): Automatically prevents source documents from being reused as "from documents" in multiple target documents by managing the preventUseAsFromDoc flag to maintain document chain integrity. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPreventUpdateDetailedRemarkLines](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPreventUpdateDetailedRemarkLines.html): Prevents updates to existing detailed remark lines while preserving the ability to add new lines. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPreventUseAsFromDocOfAField](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPreventUseAsFromDocOfAField.html): Prevents documents from being used as "from documents" by setting the preventUseAsFromDoc flag to true. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPrintFormToPrinter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPrintFormToPrinter.html): Prints entity forms directly to a specified printer using Jasper Reports. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAPrintReportToPrinter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAPrintReportToPrinter.html): Prints predefined reports directly to a specified printer using Jasper Reports. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARecommitFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARecommitFromQuery.html): Bulk recommits entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARefreshCriticalErrors](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARefreshCriticalErrors.html): Refreshes the system's critical errors cache to update error notifications and status indicators. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARefreshGoogleDriveOrMailToken](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARefreshGoogleDriveOrMailToken.html): Refreshes Google OAuth tokens for Google Drive or Gmail integration by re-authenticating and testing the connection. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARegenAccEffects](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARegenAccEffects.html): Regenerates accounting effects for entities implementing IGeneratesAccountingRequest. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARegenAccFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARegenAccFromQuery.html): Bulk regenerates accounting effects for entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAReviseUnReviseFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAReviseUnReviseFromQuery.html): Bulk marks entities as revised or unrevised based on a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARevokeApproval](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARevokeApproval.html): Revokes approval for entities currently in approval workflows. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunBulkMassagesFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunBulkMassagesFromQuery.html): Description: Send bulk message notifications for all records returned by a SQL query - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunEntityFlow](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunEntityFlow.html): Executes another entity flow by its business code. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunEntityFlowFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunEntityFlowFromQuery.html): Bulk executes an entity flow on multiple entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunManualNotification](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunManualNotification.html): Triggers a manual notification for the current entity using a predefined notification definition. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunManualNotificationFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunManualNotificationFromQuery.html): Bulk sends manual notifications to multiple entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EARunTaskSchedule](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EARunTaskSchedule.html): Manually executes a predefined task schedule by its business code. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASQLToCSVAttachmentField](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASQLToCSVAttachmentField.html): Runs a SQL query and stores the result as a delimited text (CSV) file inside an attachment field of the record being saved. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASQLToCSVEmail](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASQLToCSVEmail.html): Executes a SQL query, exports results to CSV format, and emails the CSV file as an attachment. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASQLToCSVFile](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASQLToCSVFile.html): Executes a SQL query and exports results to CSV file format. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASaveDraftsFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASaveDraftsFromQuery.html): Bulk saves draft entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASaveRecordsFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASaveRecordsFromQuery.html): Bulk saves entities identified by a SQL query. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASaveToAnotherServer](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASaveToAnotherServer.html): Synchronizes data between different Nama ERP servers by sending entity records to remote servers. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASaveToAnotherServerUsingJSON](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASaveToAnotherServerUsingJSON.html): Synchronizes data between Nama ERP servers using JSON format for data transmission. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAScaleImage](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAScaleImage.html): Resizes image attachments in entity fields to specified dimensions while maintaining aspect ratio. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAScaleMasterFileImage](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAScaleMasterFileImage.html): Specialized image scaling action that processes the main file attachment of MasterFile entities. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASendHttpRequestByTempo](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASendHttpRequestByTempo.html): Generates HTTP requests using Tempo templates and queues them for asynchronous execution. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASendNotSentTaxAuthorityDocuments](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASendNotSentTaxAuthorityDocuments.html): A catch-up sweep for e-invoicing. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASetCreationDateToEndOfDay](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASetCreationDateToEndOfDay.html): This entity action is currently unsupported and will throw an error when executed. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASetCreationDateToStartOfDay](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASetCreationDateToStartOfDay.html): Adjusts the entity's creation date to the start of the day (00:00:00). - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASetFieldByTemplate](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASetFieldByTemplate.html): Sets an entity field value using a Tempo template that can include dynamic content based on the current entity's data. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EASortFields](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EASortFields.html): Sorts detail collections within an entity based on specified field values. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAWathqAddressFetcher](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAWathqAddressFetcher.html): Fetches address information from Saudi government's Wathq platform using Commercial Registration National Number. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAWathqBasicInfoFetcher](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAWathqBasicInfoFetcher.html): Fetches basic commercial registration information from Saudi government's Wathq platform. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAWathqCommercialInfoFetcher](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAWathqCommercialInfoFetcher.html): Fetches commercial registration information from Saudi government's Wathq platform using Commercial Registration National Number. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAWordTemplate](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/EAWordTemplate.html): Processes Microsoft Word document templates by replacing placeholders with entity data. - entities: EntityFlow
- [SQLDraftImporter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/SQLDraftImporter.html): Imports entities from SQL query results and saves them as draft records. - entities: EntityFlow
- [SQLDraftImporterFromDifferentDataSource](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/SQLDraftImporterFromDifferentDataSource.html): Imports entities from SQL queries executed against external databases and saves them as draft records. - entities: EntityFlow
- [SQLImporter](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/SQLImporter.html): Imports entities from SQL query results and saves them as committed records immediately. - entities: EntityFlow
- [SQLImporterFromDifferentDataSource](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/core/SQLImporterFromDifferentDataSource.html): Imports entities from SQL queries executed against external databases and saves them as committed records immediately. - entities: EntityFlow

### Groovy Script Examples

- [Groovy Script Examples](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/): These pages are ready-made Groovy scripts for entity flows and task schedules, each one checked on a demo database before it was published.
- [Add Free Lines From the References on Each Sales Line](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAAddFreeLinesFromLineReferences.html): A Groovy script that turns up to three item references on each sales line, with their quantities, into free lines placed right under that line. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesOrder, SalesInvoice
- [Number Lot-Tracked Lines by Item Section and Year](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAAutoLotIdFromItemSectionAndYear.html): A Groovy script that gives every lot-tracked document line a running number such as QC-26-RAW00001 in Text 1, counted separately for each item section and year. - entities: EntityFlow, ItemSection
- [Recalculate an Invoice's Totals After a Field Map](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACalculateMoneyFields.html): A Groovy flow line that recalculates an invoice's line values, discounts, taxes and totals, for use right after a field map that changes prices on Validate On Save or a later event. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesInvoice
- [Clear Attendance Punches Recorded at Midnight](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAClearFromDateIfFromTimeIsMidnight.html): Two Groovy scripts that clear a Time Attendance line's check-in or check-out when the attendance machine recorded it as 00:00, so a missing punch is not read as a punch at midnight. - entities: EntityFlow, TimeAttendance
- [Clear the Locator When the Warehouse Does Not Use Locators](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAClearLocatorWhenWarehouseDoesNotAllowLocators.html): A Groovy script that clears the locator of every document line whose warehouse is empty or does not use locators. - entities: EntityFlow, Warehouse
- [Clear Lots That Were Never Received, and Unused Dimensions](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAClearLotIdsWithNoItemDimensionsQty.html): A Groovy script that clears, on every document line, the dimensions the item does not use and any lot the item has never had stock of. - entities: EntityFlow
- [Link Sales Return Lines to the Invoices They Came From](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACollectInvoicesInReturn.html): A Groovy script that finds the sales invoice lines behind each line of a sales return by query, splits a line across several invoices when needed, and copies each invoice line's price. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesReturn
- [Collect a Purchase Invoice's Stock Receipts From Its Car Receipts](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACollectStockReceiptsByFromDoc.html): A Groovy script that fills a purchase invoice's Stock Documents grid with the stock receipts made from the Car Receipts of the invoice's From Document. - entities: EntityFlow, PurchaseInvoice
- [Keep the Prices of the Document a Sales Document Was Made From](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACopyLinePriceAndHeaderDiscountFromFromDoc.html): Two Groovy scripts that make sales document lines take the price of the line they were made from, and the header discount percentage of the source document, also through a stock issue. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesInvoice, SalesOrder
- [Move a Serial Number Typed by Mistake Into the Lot](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACopySerialToLot.html): A Groovy script that, for items tracked by lot but not by serial, moves a number typed in the Serial Number column into the empty Lot ID. - entities: EntityFlow
- [Hide Entries and Vouchers Behind Their Account's View Capability](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACopyViewCapabilityFromAccountToJournalEntry.html): Two Groovy scripts that give a journal entry, or a receipt or payment voucher, the View Capability of the first account on its lines, so only users allowed to see that account can open the document. - entities: EntityFlow, JournalEntry, ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher
- [Reserve a Draft's Code When It Is Saved](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACreateAliasesForDrafts.html): A Groovy Save Draft flow that registers a draft record's codes at once, the way committing does, so no other record can be saved with the same code while the draft waits. - entities: EntityFlow
- [Number Voucher Lines per Subsidiary and Fiscal Year](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EACreateSerialForLineSubsidiary.html): A Groovy script that gives every receipt or payment voucher line a running number per subsidiary within the fiscal year, written to N1 and to the line's Narration. - entities: EntityFlow, ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher
- [Add a Service Fees Line to the Electronic Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAEInvoiceCreationWithCustomServiceFees.html): A Groovy script that runs when the electronic invoice is built and adds one extra line for the sales document's Service Fees 1, as a fixed item with tax 1 at 15%, without changing the document. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesInvoice
- [Fill the Item's Default Revision on Document Lines](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAFillDefaultRevision.html): A Groovy script that gives every document line with an empty revision the item's default revision, or its first revision when none is marked as default. - entities: EntityFlow, InvItem
- [Fill the Default Size and Color When a Committed Document Is Edited](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAFillDefaultSizeAndColor.html): A Groovy script that, when an already committed document is saved again, puts the item's default size and color on lines whose size or color is empty or wrong, and clears them for items without sizes or colors. - entities: EntityFlow, InvItem
- [Rebuild a Cancel Contract's Expense Lines From the Lease](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAFillExpensesWithRecommitRECancelContract.html): A Groovy script that clears the Expense grid of a real-estate Cancel Contract and rebuilds it from the lease's non-installment lines every time the document is saved. - entities: EntityFlow, RECancelContract
- [Show What the System Thinks Each Day Is for an Employee](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAFindDaysInfoForEmployee.html): A Groovy diagnostic that lists, day by day, the attendance shift the system finds for an employee and whether each day counts as a holiday, a weekend or a weekly rest day. - entities: EntityFlow, AttendancePlan, AttendanceShift, Employee
- [Rewrite an Item's Unit Conversions to the Base Unit](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAFixUOMConversionsToBaseUnit.html): A Groovy script that rewrites an item's chained unit conversions, such as 1 Pallet = 50 Carton, as direct conversions to the base unit, such as 1 Pallet = 1200 Piece. - entities: EntityFlow, InvItem
- [Create One Purchase Order per Supplier From a Purchase Quotation](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAGenMultiplePurchaseOrdersFromQuotation.html): Two Groovy scripts that split a purchase quotation into one purchase order, or one purchase invoice, per supplier named on its lines, and keep them in step every time the quotation is saved. - entities: EntityFlow, PurchaseQuotation, PurchaseOrder, PurchaseInvoice
- [Tick a Line Flag on Every Line That Shares a Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAGroovyUpdateRefInMiscPurchaseInvDetails.html): A Groovy script for the miscellaneous invoice that ticks a yes/no line field on every line sharing the reference of the first ticked line, and unticks it everywhere else. Both fields are chosen through parameters. - entities: EntityFlow, MiscPurchaseInvoice
- [Fill Postal Parcels Sort Lines From IPS](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAIPSCDSFetchMailItemData.html): A Groovy script that asks IPS about every line of an IPS Postal Parcels Sort and fills in the mail item's weight, classification, origin country, HS codes, receiver name and description. - entities: EntityFlow, IPSPostalParcelsSort
- [Learn an Item's Default Locator From Stock Movements](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EALearnDefaultLocatorFromStockTransfer.html): Two Groovy scripts that record, on the item, the locator a stock transfer or an opening stock document put it in, so later documents fill that locator by themselves. - entities: EntityFlow, StockTransfer, OpeningStockDocument, InvItem
- [Maintain Limit Sales Qty Lines From Items and Customers](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAMaintainLimitSalesQtyFromItem.html): Two Groovy scripts that keep a Limit Sales Qty record in step with the items and customers that are saved, finding or creating the record with a query and a fields map. - entities: EntityFlow, LimitSalesQty, InvItem, Customer
- [Mark the From Document as Fulfilled](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAMarkFromDocFulfilled.html): A Groovy script that writes Fullfilled into Description 1 of a from-document once the documents made from it cover every one of its lines, and clears it otherwise. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesOrder, SalesInvoice
- [Lock Saved Price Lines on Items and Sales Price Lists](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAPreventChangingItemPriceLines.html): Two Groovy scripts that refuse to save an item or a sales price list when one of its existing price lines was deleted or changed. New lines can still be added. - entities: EntityFlow, InvItem, SalesPriceList
- [Validate an Item's Sizes and Colors Grid](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAPreventDifferentNamesForSameSizeOrColor.html): Two Groovy validations for the item's Sizes and Colors grid. One refuses a size or color code used with two different names; the other refuses two default lines for the same size and color. - entities: EntityFlow, InvItem
- [Refuse a Document Whose Quantities Differ From Its From Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAQtyMustMatchFromDocPerItem.html): A Groovy script that refuses to save a supply chain document unless, item by item and unit by unit, its total quantities equal those of its From Document. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesInvoice
- [Keep Only a User's Last Mobile Device Token](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EARemoveAllFCMTokens.html): A Groovy manual flow on users that keeps only the newest mobile app device token of a user, so push notifications stop going to old phones or arriving several times. - entities: EntityFlow, User
- [Drop Salary Documents of Another Period From a Salary Sheet](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EARemoveSalaryDocsFromSalarySheetWithDifferentPeriod.html): A Groovy script that removes from a Salary Sheet every line whose salary document belongs to a different fiscal period than the sheet. - entities: EntityFlow, SalarySheet
- [Refuse Serial Numbers That Are Not 15 Characters Long](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EASerialNumberLen.html): A Groovy validation that refuses to save a document when any serial number on its lines is not exactly 15 characters long, marking each wrong serial on its line. - entities: EntityFlow
- [Set a Default Locator on Lines Without One](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EASetDefaultLocatorIfEmpty.html): Two Groovy scripts that put a fixed default locator on document lines that have none, either for every item or only for the items of chosen item sections. - entities: EntityFlow, Locator, ItemSection
- [Set the Delivery Status of the Lines a Document Was Made From](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EASetDeliveryStatusInFromDocLines.html): A Groovy script that sets a fixed delivery status on the source lines of a document, even when the source is several documents back in the chain. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesOrder, SalesInvoice
- [Force Do Not Update Prices At All on Sales Return Request Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EASetDoNotUpdateSalesPrice.html): A Groovy script on the Document Term screen that ticks Do Not Update Prices At All on every Sales Return Request term when it is saved. - entities: EntityFlow, DocumentTerm, SalesReturnRequest
- [Record Inventory Effects Under the Warehouse's Analysis Set](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EASetInvRequestAnalysisSetFromWarehouse.html): A Groovy script that runs just before a document sends its inventory transaction request and gives every request line the analysis set of its warehouse. - entities: EntityFlow, Warehouse, StockIssue
- [Fill a Forgotten Punch's Hour From the Employee's Shift](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EASetPermissionHourFromAttendanceShift.html): A Groovy script that sets a Forgot Check In or Forgot Check Out leave permission's hour to the start or end of the employee's shift on that day. - entities: EntityFlow, LeavePermission, AttendanceShift, AttendancePlan
- [Link Free Item Lines of a Sales Return to the Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EASetSourceLineIDForFreeItemInSalesReturn.html): A Groovy script that fills the Source Line Id of free item lines on a sales return, so each free line points at the matching free line of the invoice it is returned from. - entities: EntityFlow, SalesReturn
- [Send One Account's Ledger Lines in Local Currency at Rate 1](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EASetTransCurrencyToLocalCurrencyAndRateOne.html): A Groovy script that rewrites the ledger lines of one account in the local currency at rate 1, just before a document sends its accounting request. - entities: EntityFlow, JournalEntry
- [Spread an Assembly BOM Line Into One Line per Item of a Class](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EASpreadAssemblyBOMLineByItemClass.html): A Groovy script that replaces an Assembly BOM line pointing at an Item Class 4 record with one line for every committed item of that class. - entities: EntityFlow, AssemblyBOM, ItemClass4 - menu: Inventory → Assembly Documents → Assembly BOM
- [Treat a Late Check-In as a Check-Out](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EATimeAttendanceMakeInOutIfBeforeTime.html): A Groovy script that turns a lone Time Attendance check-in made after a cut-off time into a check-out, for attendance machines that do not tell the two apart. - entities: EntityFlow, TimeAttendance
- [Update Items' Warehouse Settings From a Purchase Return Request](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAUpdateItemDimensionsFromPurchaseReturnReqLines.html): A Groovy script that, when a purchase return request is committed, writes values from its lines into each item's dimensions grid row for that warehouse, through fixed numeric fields and an optional field map. - entities: EntityFlow, PurchaseReturnReq, InvItem - menu: Purchases → Documents → Purchase Return Request
- [Copy Project Contract Term Codes Into Its Budgets](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAUpdateProjectContractTermCodeInBudgets.html): A Groovy script that writes each project contract term's code into the Project Term Code of the matching lines of the contract's estimated and executive budgets when the contract is saved. - entities: EntityFlow, ProjectContract, ContractingEstimatedBudget, ContractingExecutiveBudget
- [Rebuild Quantity Tracking for Documents From a Query](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAUpdateQtyTrackingEffectsFromQuery.html): A Groovy script that rebuilds the satisfied and remaining quantities that documents leave on their source documents, for every document an SQL query returns. - entities: EntityFlow, TaskSchedule
- [Cap a Yearly Allowance per Employee on Payment Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/groovy/EAYearlyLimitPerEmployeeInPVRequest.html): A Groovy script that checks payment requests against a yearly allowance per employee, per item and in total, for example a staff medical allowance, and writes the running totals on each line. - entities: EntityFlow, PVRequest, DetailedRemark

- [EAGenJournalEntry](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/accounting/EAGenJournalEntry.html): Automatically creates journal entries (accounting vouchers) from any document in the system, so that their accounting effects are recorded in the ledger automatically. - entities: EntityFlow

- [EAOyoonWorkPlaceUpdateToUpdateInfo](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/hr/EAOyoonWorkPlaceUpdateToUpdateInfo.html): Automatically generates or updates employee information update documents when workplace changes are committed or deleted. - entities: EntityFlow

- [EAUpdateDeliveryStatusFromSalesDocToFromDoc](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUpdateDeliveryStatusFromSalesDocToFromDoc.html): Updates delivery status information in parent sales documents based on changes in the current document. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAUpdateItemPricesFromPriceList](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUpdateItemPricesFromPriceList.html): Recomputes the price of every item in a sales price list and writes it into a numeric field of the item card. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAUpdateItemPricesFromQuery](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUpdateItemPricesFromQuery.html): Recomputes prices for the items returned by an "Items Finder Query" and writes each price into a numeric field of the item card. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAUpdateLotIdDates](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAUpdateLotIdDates.html): Updates lot date information (expiry, production, retest dates) across all system tables based on the dates specified in document lines. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAValidateSFDARSDIncomingDispatches](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAValidateSFDARSDIncomingDispatches.html): Refuses to save a Purchase Invoice or Car Purchase Invoice whose medicine lines do not match the SFDA RSD dispatch notification the supplier sent for that delivery. - entities: EntityFlow
- [EAWebEngageSendInvoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/EAWebEngageSendInvoice.html): Sends a sales invoice (or sales return) to the WebEngage marketing platform. - entities: EntityFlow
- [SetQuantityToOneAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/SetQuantityToOneAction.html): Sets default quantity values to 1 for document lines that have zero or empty quantities. - entities: EntityFlow
- [SetSecondUOMToDefaultIfEmpty](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/SetSecondUOMToDefaultIfEmpty.html): Automatically assigns the default secondary unit of measure to document lines when the secondary UOM field is empty. - entities: EntityFlow
- [UniqueBOXInsideStockReceipt](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/UniqueBOXInsideStockReceipt.html): Validates that each box number is used only once per item within a stock receipt document. - entities: EntityFlow
- [ValidateSorceLinesOfFromDocAction](https://docs.namasoft.com/entity-flows/supplychain/ValidateSorceLinesOfFromDocAction.html): Validates that all lines in the current document have corresponding source lines in the parent document when the document is based on another document (fromDoc relationship). - entities: EntityFlow

## Video Tutorials

- [Video Tutorials](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/) (ar: شروحات الفيديو): Landing page for Nama ERP video tutorials with timestamped written summaries: featured walkthroughs and the supply chain, Report Wizard and HR payroll collections.
- [Nama ERP's New UI and AI Integration Through MCP](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/new-ui-and-mcp-webinar.html) (ar: واجهة نما الجديدة وربط الذكاء الاصطناعي عبر MCP): Webinar summary: the new interface (menu, list views, user settings, mobile, chat, announcements, data-entry grids, dashboards) and connecting AI agents to Nama through MCP.
- [Documentation for the Nama ERP Installation Video and Supporting Software](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/installation-video.html) (ar: توثيق فيديو تنصيب Nama ERP والبرامج المساعدة): Timestamped notes for the Nama ERP installation video: installing SQL Server and its tools, running several Tomcat instances on one server, restoring databases, database users, backup folders and schedules, SSL certificates, DNS and testing the installation.

### Supply Chain Videos

- [Supply Chain Videos](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/supply-chain-videos/) (ar: فيديوهات سلسلة التوريد)
- [Inventory Costing Explained - Video 1](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/supply-chain-videos/cost-video-1.html) (ar: فيديو طريقة عمل التكاليف - 1): Learn how to manage and accurately determine inventory cost using the FIFO system, with a detailed explanation of cost-tracking dimensions and their impact on inventory reports and profitability.
- [Inventory Costing Methods - Video 2](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/supply-chain-videos/cost-video-2.html) (ar: فيديو طريقة عمل التكاليف - 2): A comprehensive and detailed explanation of inventory cost calculation systems and the impact of supply operations, purchase returns, and taxes on them in business and warehouse environments.
- [Costing Tutorial Video - 3](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/supply-chain-videos/cost-video-3.html) (ar: فيديو طريقة عمل التكاليف - 3): Learn the fundamentals of supply costing, letters of credit, and the distribution of transportation and manufacturing costs in a business environment, with a detailed explanation of modern accounting tools and systems.
- [Documentation: Explaining Actual and Indirect Costs in the Manufacturing System](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/manufacturing-actual-overhead.html) (ar: توثيق شرح التكاليف غير المباشرة والفعلي في نظام تصنيع): Timestamped notes for the manufacturing video on actual indirect costs: defining the indirect cost file and cost types, calculating actual overheads from purchase invoices and accounts, closing production orders, and distributing the costs over time.

### Report Wizard Videos

- [Report Wizard Videos](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/report-wizard-videos/) (ar: فيديوهات أداة إنشاء التقارير)
- [Video (1): Report Designer Tool Walkthrough](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/report-wizard-videos/report-wizard-webinar-1.html) (ar: فيديو (1) شرح أداة انشاء التقار): Notes for the first report wizard webinar: the parts of a report, choosing tables and fields, hyperlinks, grouping and aggregation, parameters and filters, sorting, calculated expressions, and exporting the finished report.
- [Detailed Guide to Grouping, Data Sources, and Report Sorting in Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/report-wizard-videos/report-wizard-webinar-2.html) (ar: شرح تفصيلي لجروبنج (Grouping) ومصادر البيانات وترتيب التقارير في Nama ERP): Video walkthrough of the Report Wizard: grouping by customer and branch with totals, controlling sorting, data sources for aggregating sales, returns and collections, and account statement reports.
- [Complete Documentation for Creating Cross Tab Reports, Account Statements, and Inventory Movement Using the Report Builder](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/report-wizard-videos/report-wizard-webinar-3.html) (ar: توثيق كامل لإنشاء تقارير الكروس تاب، كشف الحساب، وحركة المخزون باستخدام أداة إنشاء التقارير): Video summary: building Cross Tab reports, account statements and inventory movement reports with the Report Wizard, step by step.
- [Documentation for the Sales Invoice Report Training Video and New GUI Features](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/report-wizard-videos/report-wizard-webinar-4.html) (ar: توثيق فيديو تدريب تقرير فاتورة المبيعات وميزات الجيو الجديدة): Timestamped notes for the fourth report wizard webinar: building a sales invoice report with a date parameter, hyperlinks to an account statement, merged headers, conditional styling, cross tab reports, a per-salesman filter, and a tour of the new interface.
- [Creating a Print Template for a Filter Document Screen](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/report-wizard-videos/report-wizard-webinar-5.html) (ar: شرح إنشاء نموذج طباعة شاشة مستند تصفية): Video summary: designing a Report Wizard print template for a document with several grids, using the multi-cell grid layout, merged cells, notes, signatures and an employee custody example.
- [Comprehensive Documentation: Report Wizard Reports and Permission Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/report-wizard-videos/report-wizard-webinar-6.html) (ar: توثيق شامل لمحتوى الفيديو حول إعداد تقارير الريبورت ويزرد وإدارة الصلاحيات): Video summary: Report Wizard report permissions, filtering report data by the user's branch, a sales invoice report, data sources and joins, SQL, and first and last invoice per customer.

### Human Resources Videos

- [Human Resources Videos](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/hr/) (ar: فيديوهات الموارد البشرية)
- [Detailed Explanation of the Payroll Management System in Nama ERP - 1](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/hr/hr-course-1.html) (ar: شرح مفصل لنظام إدارة الرواتب في نظام نما - 1): Notes for part 1 of the payroll training course: salary components and component types, fixed and variable items, absences, bonuses, penalties and advances, the base for tax and insurance, rounding, priority and order, and the accounting effect of components.
- [Detailed Explanation of the Payroll Management System in Nama ERP - 2](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/hr/hr-course-2.html) (ar: شرح مفصل لنظام إدارة الرواتب في نظام نما - 2): Notes for part 2 of the payroll training course: calculation formulas for social insurance, Egyptian tax brackets and deductions, performance indicators, attendance and shifts, absences, holidays, overtime and lateness, and missing fingerprint records.
- [Detailed Explanation of the Payroll Management System in Nama ERP - 3](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/hr/hr-course-3.html) (ar: شرح مفصل لنظام إدارة الرواتب في نظام نما - 3): Video summary, HR payroll course part 3: performance indicators, formulas, repetition counts versus ranges, overtime and lateness brackets, time rounding, taxes and payroll periods.
- [Detailed Explanation of the Payroll System in Nama ERP - 4](https://docs.namasoft.com/videos/hr/hr-course-4.html) (ar: شرح مفصل لنظام إدارة الرواتب في نظام نما - 4): Video summary, HR payroll course part 4: attendance and departure, the Timer, shifts, leave, the mobile attendance app, importing fingerprint data from Excel and handling double shifts.
